chapters.title: Chapter 201: Hijack the Aura Airship
paragraphs: "what happened?"
Cao Zuo's voice was extremely cold, "Why don't you do anything when everyone is here?"
"Back to your lord!"
"Target...the target disappeared!"
A King Wu replied tremblingly, "Our spiritual power covers all routes, but he just disappeared out of thin air!"
"What? Gone!?"
Cao Zuo's expression changed, and immediately murmured, "Does he have a treasure that shields his mental perception?
It is very possible that you will be divided into two groups. You two will go in and search carefully, and don't miss any corners. "
"Yes!"
King Wu, who was named by Cao Zuo's name, immediately rushed into the building and started searching.
at the same time.
Eastern City Airport.
An Aura airship just landed, and a large number of passengers poured out.
Most of these people came to recruit students from Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
"This is the Oriental City, it is much bigger than our Baiqin City!"
"Yes, looking at those high-rise buildings, it's like the legendary age of peace."
"It's so cool to be able to come to Dongfang City, I must have fun, even if I can't enter Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, it is enough."
Everyone in Baiqin City talked about it.
A staff member of an airport nearby curled his lips and said, "It's good for Eastern City, but strange things have happened frequently recently.
In just one or two days, Dan Wangjing Qianyi died, Qianyi Pavilion was flattened, Zihua Tower was in chaos, Jingxin Dan Tower was robbed, and countless people died during the period.
Just now, the airport issued an order that Xu Jin is not allowed to leave. I am afraid that another major event will happen. You should be careful. "
"what!?
"Even so in Dongfang City?"
"Who would dare to do this in Eastern City? This is too arrogant!"
All the people around were surprised, looking at each other and couldn't help but exclaim.
And just now.
A figure flashed away in front of them, directly into the aura airship after the guests.
This figure is naturally the clone controlled by Su Lang.
As for the previous clone, he has already taken back the mysterious space.
After entering the spirit airship, Su Lang went directly to the cockpit.
"who!?"
"Leave immediately, this is not where you should be!"
The warrior responsible for guarding the cockpit immediately shouted loudly.
"Humph!"
Su Lang smiled coldly, and the Wu Wang-level aura burst out of him.
In an instant, the cockpit guard and the driver were stunned!
"Wu...Master Wu!"
The cockpit guard softened his knees and knelt directly on the ground.
The driver also trembled, and the cold sweat on his forehead was immersed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Now, take off immediately."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Otherwise, you will be at your own risk."
"Yes!"
"Master Wu, I will take off!"
The driver shook his body and immediately manipulated the aura airship to take off.
And this change immediately attracted the attention of airport staff.
"Aura Airship No. 39, please stop taking off immediately!"
"Repeat, Reiki Airship No. 39, please stop taking off immediately and land in the current area for inspection!"
The sound of mid-term fullness spread throughout the airport.
"what!?"
"What's the situation?"
"Why did our aura airship in Baiqin City suddenly take off!"
"Such a thing happened when I first arrived in Dongfang City. This is exactly the time of troublesome times!"
Everyone in Bai Qincheng who had been talking about before was shocked.
Other passers-by at the airport were also shocked.
They know, I'm afraid something is going to happen again!
at the same time.
King Wu and Martial Commander who were sent by Cao Zuo to handle the airport also changed their expressions immediately.
"At this moment, it suddenly took off..."
"It is most likely that Su Lang tried to escape!"
A long-haired martial king said with surprise and joy, "Quickly, report the news to Cao Zuo guard first, and the deputy guard, let's get on together and stop this aura airship!"
As soon as his voice fell, he immediately rose into the air with another black-faced Wu Wang and flew towards the aura airship where Su Lang clone was.
The other military commanders began to report the news and arranged other means!

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Lie down for me
paragraphs: "Don't worry about the order from the airport, continue flying."
On the spiritual airship, Su Lang's mouth gradually conjured up a playful smile.
"Goooo..."
The spirit airship piloted the warrior to swallow a spit, and said bitterly, "My lord, if we continue to fly, they will take measures!"
"Anyway, keep flying."
Su Lang curled his lips and looked out the window immediately.
At this time, the two Wu Wangs had already caught up, their speed was faster than the aura airship, and the distance between the two sides was gradually shrinking.
"Two martial kings."
Su Lang narrowed his eyes and directly called up their attribute panel.
Looking at the information panels of the two King Wu, Su Lang showed a trace of disdain.
These two martial kings are only intermediate martial kings, and all four-dimensional levels are hovering around the intermediate martial kings.
At this time, the two intermediate Wu Wangs had already chased the aura airship.
"Stop flying immediately!"
Long-haired King Wu shouted sharply, "Otherwise, we will have to do it!"
"Spiritual perception!"
Blackfaced King Wu's eyes burst open, his mental power surging out, enveloping the entire aura airship.
The almost all-pervasive mental power quickly spread to the cockpit of the aura airship.
Immediately afterwards, the black-faced King Wu saw a young man with a calm expression sitting on the sofa drinking.
"It's really that Su Lang!"
"Quick, let's rush in and catch it alive!"
The black-faced King Wu had a surprise on his face. Once he caught this King Wu, they would have done a great job!
The other long-haired Wu Wang was also in ecstasy, with a movement of aura in his body, his speed soared again.
Between two or three breaths.
The two Wu Wang flew to the back of the aura airship.
"Bone Jiyue!"
Long-haired King Wu roared, and a claw fell, tearing a crack on the surface of the aura airship.
Immediately, the two entered in file and rushed towards Su Lang clone.
After two breaths.
They appeared in front of Su Lang.
"The speed is not bad."
Looking at the two Martial Kings in front of him, Su Lang put down his glass and smiled leisurely.
"Huh! Of course!"
"You are Su Lang, are you self-defeating your own cultivation base and catching it with no effort, or let us do it?"
Two Wu Wangs surrounded Su Lang, one on the left and the other on the right, with six characters ‘we will eat you’ on their faces.
"Tsk tsk, let me catch it?"
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, "Could you not know that Ji Hong, the fifth elder of the Ji family, died in my hands?"
"Huh! What about you killing Ji Hong?"
Long-haired King Wu sneered, "Do you think the two of us are just simple intermediate Kings?"
"Stop talking nonsense.
"Since he refuses to catch it, let him see our methods!"
The black-faced military commander's eyes were fierce and murderous, and he immediately shouted, "Blood burning my heart!"
In the next moment, his flesh and blood suddenly disappeared, and the whole person became a skinny skeleton.
However, his breath rose to a small level in an instant.
At the same time, the long-haired martial arts commander also used this secret technique to increase his combat power to the realm of a high-level martial king.
"Humph!"
Long-haired King Wu looked at Su Lang dismissively, "Now, do you have the confidence to escape from our hands?"
"Tsk tusk, the two high-ranking martial arts are really strong."
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, "Unfortunately, in front of me, it is still not enough."
"When you die, you dare to speak quickly!"
The black-faced King Wu was so angry that he threw a punch at Su Lang, "Look at me crippling you!"
"Hehe, just with you, you want to crippled me?"
Seeing King Wu rushing over, Su Lang's mouth twitched, "Lie down for me!"
next moment!
"Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade!"
Two sword lights appeared behind the long-haired military commander and the black-faced military commander, and instantly pierced their dantian and shattered their spiritual core!
"puff!!"
The two unprepared King Wu squirted out a blood, and the spiritual power on their bodies began to overflow wildly!
The spiritual core and the dantian were destroyed at the same time, which directly abolished their cultivation base!
Looking at the long sword pierced out of the abdomen, feeling the endless pain in the body, the faces of the two martial kings showed endless panic.

chapters.title: Chapter 203: I have so many clones
paragraphs: "Tsk tsk, Xuanyun Jingyuehuo's extinguishing aura is really useful!"
"Especially for guys like you who don't like to maintain mental awareness at all times."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and then he waved his hand. With a move of the two clone long swords, they pulled away from the dantians of the two martial kings.
"Puff!"
The two King Wu opened their mouths wide and collapsed to the ground in despair.
At the same time, they also saw clearly the enemy who attacked them-two young men who were exactly like Su Lang!
"This is... the clone!?"
"This... so many clones, how is it possible!?"
The eyes of the two kings burst instantly, almost even more shocked than ordinary people seeing ghosts!
"Sorry, I have so many clones."
Su Lang smiled faintly, and with a flick of his finger, the two groups of green lotus dragon pattern fire fell on the two Wu Wangs.
"Boom!"
The cyan flame enveloped the two martial kings and burned.
"what--!"
"It hurts!!"
The two kings screamed in pain.
The strong physique that made them proud in the past has now become the source of their pain.
After a short while, the flame went out, and the two martial kings became ashes.
"Ding! You get the king's Beidou Feihong Sword*1, high-grade spiritual stone*3256, medium-grade spiritual stone*142521, low-grade spiritual stone*1565652..."
"Ding! You get the King Item Unsullied Golden Tiger Sabre*1, the high-grade spiritual stone*2256, the middle-grade spiritual stone*262521, the low-grade spiritual stone*365847..."
"It's more than one million middle-grade spirit stones, so beautiful!"
Su Lang smiled excitedly, "Moreover, there are two king weapons, these are good things."
With a thought, two king artifacts appeared in his hands.
Two king artifacts, one sword and one sword, are both junior king artifacts, and the same level as the War God Panlong Spear.
"The God of War Panlong Spear was not suitable for me, now I can change the weapon!"
With a tick at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, he passed the War God Panlong Spear and the Wushen Golden Tiger Sabre to the two clones, leaving only the Beidou Feihong Sword.
This long sword is white all over, the hilt is carved with the Big Dipper, and the blade is like a beautiful straight feather!
"Tsk tsk, it's so pretty, I like it!"
Su Lang nodded in satisfaction, then closed his clone and went to the cockpit of the airship.
The pilot and guard of the airship heard the screams of two King Wu's screams just now, and Su Lang appeared at this time, and they almost fainted with fright.
"Don't worry, I really won't kill you."
Su Lang shrugged helplessly, "You only need to get the airship out of the barrier and keep flying."
"Yes! Your lord, we must follow suit!"
The airship piloting warrior and guarding warrior looked horrified, and replied tremblingly.
Afterwards, they maximized the power of the airship and flew quickly to the western barrier.
Time moves forward.
Monsoon Street.
"What? A Su Lang appeared in the airport, hijacked the aura airship and wanted to escape?"
Cao Zuo looked at the Jade Chuanxin in his hand, his expression suddenly moved:
"Sure enough, what appeared here should be Su Lang's clone, he used the strategy of adjusting the tiger away from the mountain!
Fortunately, I sent two King Wu to monitor the airport, otherwise he might escape. "
Thinking of this, he immediately ordered King Wu next to him: "You continue to search here, I will go to the airport!"
Yes, the suspicious Cao Zuo still did not give up searching for the first Su Lang clone!
Of course, his suspicion was just a waste of effort.
After speaking, Cao Zuo soared into the air without waiting for his subordinates to answer, turning into streamer to rush to the airport.
"Although Su Lang can kill Ji Hong, he should not be an opponent under the joint hands of the Deputy Fourth Guard and Deputy Fifth Guard!"
A sneer appeared on Cao Zuo's face, "Then, when I get to the airport, Su Lang child, you must have been captured!
Dare to kill my only son, I must let you survive every day, not death! "
With endless hatred, Cao Zuo's spirit exploded, speeding up again.
About three minutes later, he arrived at the airport.
however--

Cao Zuo looked condescendingly at this subordinate, "Where are the Deputy Fourth Guard and Deputy Fifth Guard? Where is Su Lang's child?"
"Big...sir!"
"The deputy four guards and the deputy five guards went after the airship hijacked by Su Lang, but they soon lost the news!"
"We passed the letter and got no reply at all!"
The military commander kneeling on the ground said in horror, "The most important thing is that the aura airship did not stop, but flew outside the barrier!"
"what!?"
The look on Cao Zuo's face instantly turned into disbelief, "You said the Deputy Fourth Guard and Deputy Fifth Guard failed to stop the Aura Airship, and there was no news!?"
"Yes, it is!"
The military commander kneeling on the ground nodded tremblingly.
"hiss--!"
Hearing this, Cao Zuo couldn't help his eyes widening and took a breath!
He knows exactly what it means to lose audio
——This means that the two Martial Kings who chased Su Lang are most likely dead!
"There is no problem with my strategy..."
"The one on Jiyu Street is Su Lang's avatar, and the one who hijacked the aura airship is his deity!"
"But, how could this Su Lang child be so powerful?"

The horror in Cao Zuo's heart is like a tenth-level tsunami, "Although the deputy four guards and deputy five guards are only intermediate martial kings, they can burst out of the power of the senior martial king!
When the two of them joined forces, they were both defeated by Su Lang children! ? "
At this time.
The military commander kneeling on the ground cautiously said: "Guardian, we saw the aura airship flying towards the western barrier, do you want to chase it?"
"Catch up? Can you catch up?"
"You are just a bunch of waste, rice buckets!"
Cao Zuo rushed into the crown and kicked the Wu Martial Martial Artist on the ground. "Quick! Go and turn off the forbidden air formation. I will chase it myself!"
After speaking, Cao Zuo soared into the sky and flew toward the west at the fastest speed.
At the same time Cao Zuo was led out of the city by his nose.
Su Lang cancelled the perfect leaning, leaving the clone to guard the aura airship, and then withdrew all consciousness.
"Tsk tusk, the harvest this time is really not small!"

"Ding! All gold coins and spirit stones have been deposited in the system!"
"Ding! Consume 1 million middle-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 9, and the number of clones +1"
In an instant, a small purple figure condensed in the mysterious black space again.
It is the ninth clone of Su Lang!
"Cool, there is another clone with the same combat power as me.
Su Lang took a sigh of relief, "Moreover, the clone dispatch reaches level 9, and it will be level 10 soon!
With the system's urinary sex, when the clone dispatch reaches level 10, you will definitely get the bonus function, which is really exciting! "
"Brother Su Lang, you are giggling again!"
Ji Ruxue pulled Su Lang's sleeve strangely.
"what?"
Su Lang came back to his senses and said with a smile: "Haha, I'm happy when I turn Cao Zuo around!"
"Turn Cao Zuo around?"
Murong Xue asked very curiously, "Master Su Lang, Cao Zuo is Emperor Wu, how did you turn him around?"
"Haha, listen to me..."
Su Lang laughed, and then told all about how he played Cao Zuo.
"Wow! Cao Zuo is really stupid!"
"Yes, they must have never thought that those two are the clones of Brother Su Lang!"
"Now Cao Zuo is still chasing the aura airship stupidly, he is really laughing, he is still a generation of Wu Huang!"
After listening to Su Lang's account, Murong Xianxian and Ji Ruxue immediately started discussing enthusiastically.
At the same time, the two women looked at Su Lang's eyes more admired and admired.

The horror in Cao Zuo's heart is like a tenth-level tsunami, "Although the deputy four guards and deputy five guards are only intermediate martial kings, they can burst out of the power of the senior martial king!
When the two of them joined forces, they were both defeated by Su Lang children! ?
At this time.
The military commander kneeling on the ground cautiously said: "Guardian, we saw the aura airship flying towards the western barrier, do you want to chase it?"
"Catch up?
Can you catch up?"
"You are just a bunch of waste, rice buckets!"
Cao Zuo rushed into the crown and kicked the Wu Martial Martial Artist on the ground.
"Quick!
Go and turn off the forbidden air formation.
I will chase it myself!"
After speaking, Cao Zuo soared into the sky and flew toward the west at the fastest speed.
At the same time Cao Zuo was led out of the city by his nose.
Su Lang cancelled the perfect leaning, leaving the clone to guard the aura airship, and then withdrew all consciousness.
"Tsk tusk, the harvest this time is really not small!"
Su Lang opened his eyes, his eyes were full of excitement, "The system, immediately deposit my gold coin spirit stone, and then upgrade my clone dispatch function!"
"Ding!
All gold coins and spirit stones have been deposited in the system!"
"Ding!
Consume 1 million middle-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 9, and the number of clones +1"
In an instant, a small purple figure condensed in the mysterious black space again.
It is the ninth clone of Su Lang!
"Cool, there is another clone with the same combat power as me.
Su Lang took a sigh of relief, "Moreover, the clone dispatch reaches level 9, and it will be level 10 soon!
With the system's urinary sex, when the clone dispatch reaches level 10, you will definitely get the bonus function, which is really exciting!
"Brother Su Lang, you are giggling again!"
Ji Ruxue pulled Su Lang's sleeve strangely.
"what?"
Su Lang came back to his senses and said with a smile: "Haha, I'm happy when I turn Cao Zuo around!"
"Turn Cao Zuo around?"
Murong Xue asked very curiously, "Master Su Lang, Cao Zuo is Emperor Wu, how did you turn him around?"
"Haha, listen to me..."
Su Lang laughed, and then told all about how he played Cao Zuo.
"Wow!
Cao Zuo is really stupid!"
"Yes, they must have never thought that those two are the clones of Brother Su Lang!"
"Now Cao Zuo is still chasing the aura airship stupidly, he is really laughing, he is still a generation of Wu Huang!"
After listening to Su Lang's account, Murong Xianxian and Ji Ruxue immediately started discussing enthusiastically.
At the same time, the two women looked at Su Lang's eyes more admired and admired.

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Eat up one billion gold coins in one bite!
paragraphs: Watching Murong Xianxue and Ji Ruxue who were talking non-stop.
A faint smile appeared on Su Lang's face: "Sometimes it's quite comfortable to be accompanied by someone."
Immediately, he slowly raised his head, his gaze seemed to penetrate the underground building and land on the entire Eastern City.
"Now the entire Eastern City, only the mental attack of Emperor Wu can pose a great threat to me.
Although I have a ‘Swallowing Clone’ available, it is not yet known whether the Devouring Clone can stack up mental power.
And the duration of this ability is too short, it can only be used as a hole card, not too dependent.
The level of mental power must be raised quickly! "
There was a thoughtful color in Su Lang's eyes, "As long as I raise my spirit level to the fogging level, then I can walk sideways in Dongfang City in a big way."
Thinking of this, Su Lang ticked the corner of his mouth and took out a King-Order Pill from the storage space.
This pill is covered in blue, like a deep-sea jewel, it is a Shenji Heart Locking Pill that has just been refined!
King Wu wants to improve his spiritual power, in addition to his own penance, he can also use external forces.
And the pill is one of them!
However, the pill that can increase mental power is very cherished, at least it is also the pill of Wang rank.
King-rank pill, only King Pill can refine!
As for the king-rank pill that enhances mental power, many pill kings may not be able to refine them.
For example, Shenji Suoxin Pill is a kind of pill from Jing Qianyi's pill code, but Jing Qianyi has not mastered this kind of pill.
Therefore, the pill that can enhance mental power is completely invaluable. Even if King Wu wants to buy one, it is extremely difficult.
However, this is not a problem at all for Su Lang.
As long as he has enough materials, he can continuously refine Shenji Lock Heart Pill with a steady stream of energy.
And they are all perfect-quality pill, one is worth more than ten low-grade pill!
"As long as the pill is enough, I believe the 7-day mental power improvement period will be shortened again!"
Su Lang chuckled, then subdued the Shenji Lock Heart Pill in his hand.
In an instant, he felt a chill in his mind, and even his senses seemed to become clearer.
And this feeling is still getting stronger and stronger, obviously the drug is breaking out.
"It deserves to be a perfect quality pill!"
Su Lang smiled with satisfaction and asked immediately, "System, how long will my mental power level be promoted?"
"Ding! Host, your mental power level can be raised to the Ning Mist realm in just 6 days."
"Shortened by about 6 hours?"
Su Lang smiled satisfied, "Yes, it's already very good!"
Immediately afterwards, his heart moved, and a lot of Shenji Locking Heart Pill appeared in his palm!
These Shenji Locking Heart Pills are all the elixirs that Su Lang currently possesses to enhance the spiritual power, and each one is worth more than 10,000 middle-grade spirit stones.
And the total value of this pill has reached an astonishing 100,000 middle-grade spirit stone!
If converted into gold coins, it would be a full 1 billion gold coins!
However, without any hesitation, Su Lang threw it away and ate it like candy.
"boom!!"
A horrible coolness erupted from the body and instantly rushed to his mind.
Su Lang's consciousness sank into the sea of knowledge, only to see the darkness, and the thousands of silk ribbons continued to gush out, rushing into the white halo crazily.
In a short period of time, he felt his mental power soared like riding a rocket!
"If you can keep this speed..."
"In less than a day, my mental power can be promoted to the fogging level!"
Su Lang showed a refreshing expression, "Unfortunately, I ran out of pill and alchemy materials, so I have to collect materials!
At present, Cao Zuo is drawn away by me, and Emperor Ji's Wu Huang can't get out. This is a good opportunity to collect ‘interest’! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang took out the map and began to search for the pill shops in the entire Oriental City.
Soon, the four targets appeared in Su Lang's eyes.
There is no Dange in Oriental Dancheng, Jijia Danlou, and Xinglong Danfang.
This is the largest pill shop in Dongfang City, each one is bigger than Jingxin Pill Building!
Among them, Oriental Pill City is affiliated to the Union Branch, Jijia Danlou and Wuyou Dange are Ji’s properties, and Xinglong Danfang is Cao Zuo’s private property.
"Dongfang Danlou has a public welfare nature, forget it."
Su Lang raised his eyebrows and turned his gaze to the other targets, "Then, you will be the three!"
Immediately, his mind moved and sent the clone out.
At the same time, Dongfang City was outside the western barrier.
Cao Zuo used all his strength to hunt down the Aura airship, and at this time he had chased it to a place less than five kilometers away from the Aura airship.

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Cao Zuo's Liu Yinghuaming
paragraphs: "Humph!"
"Hijacked an Aura airship and wanted to escape? It's just a wishful thinking!"
Cao Zuo let out a cold snort, with a look of contempt on his face.
Compared to the subsonic speed of the aura airship, his speed reached two or three times the speed of sound!
The ending of the aura airship being overtaken was destined from the beginning!
"Su Lang child, when I catch you, I'll say you Ling Chi again!"
With a sneer, Cao Zuo continued to chase forward, and his mental perception spread rapidly.
Not long after, his mental perception covered the entire aura airship.
However, after a search, the disdain on Cao Zuo's face completely disappeared, becoming gloomy.
"Gone!? How could it be possible?"
"Could it be that you escaped from the aura airship halfway?"
"That's not right! When I was in the city, I already saw the airship from a distance."
"From beginning to end, no one came out of the airship at all!"
With strong suspicion, Cao Zuo caught up with the aura airship and got in through the crack torn by the long-haired Wu Wang.
After another search, Cao Zuo's face became as black as the bottom of a pot.
Really do not have!
There is no third person in the Aura Airship except for the piloting warrior and the guarding warrior!
"What the is going on? Could it be that he didn't get on the airship at all?"
"No, it's not right! He is not on the airship, how did he kill my two subordinates!?
"Weird, it's so weird. It disappeared out of thin air in Monsoon Street, and it disappeared silently here!
Could it be... Could it be that he mastered the legendary space attribute technique and could tear the space for teleportation! ? "
Thinking of this, Cao Zuo's expression suddenly changed, "It should be so!
He actually possesses a spatial attribute technique, which is a legendary god-level technique!
No wonder...no wonder he dared to kill people in Dongfang City unscrupulously, even I didn't even look at him.
With the spatial attribute technique, if he wants to escape, it will be difficult to chase after him!
At this moment, he definitely didn't know where he was going, except for searching by breath indexing method, he couldn't be found by ordinary methods anyway!
Damn it! God thief, why did you let me meet this Su Lang chopsticks! ?
How can I avenge my son's revenge——! ? "
Cao Zuo was so angry that his seven orifices were producing smoke, his eyes were blood red, his veins were exposed, and he kept shaking!
As the guard of the Eastern City, as a martial emperor.
He couldn't even avenge his son's hatred, but he was dragged around by the nose!
This is simply a shame!
If this matter is known, then his fame will be ruined.
The rest of his life will be spent in the ridicule and contempt of others!
Any low-level warrior can talk about his useless martial emperor before and after dinner!
"what--!!"
"Su Lang child, you crap, I will kill you!"
Cao Zuo let out a loud cry of collapse, and immediately destroyed the aura airship to vent his anger.
But at this moment.
In Cao Zuo's spatial ring, Chuanxin Jade Brand suddenly shocked!
"A bunch of trash, dare to send me a letter!?"
Cao Zuoqiang held back his grief and indignation, took out the letter from the space ring and glanced at it.
And this look immediately solidified his grief and anger.
Immediately afterwards, his face suddenly burst into ecstasy!
"Su Lang child!!
Unexpectedly, you didn't even escape from the city, and you still dare to do my Xinglong Danfang! ?
Hahahaha, great, great! It's really bright!
If you escaped outside the city, I really can't help you!
But if you dare to stay in the city, you are all doing it!
As long as you are in the city, you are a turtle in the urn, and I can catch you anyway.
Even if you have the spatial attribute technique, it will not help. In the barrier formation, there is space to imprison the formation! "
At this moment, Cao Zuo didn't care about the loss of Xinglong Danfang.
Because in his eyes, as long as he can catch Su Lang's revenge, it doesn't matter how much he pays!
"Dog offal, you still have to fall into my hands after all!"
A hideous smile and killing intent appeared on Cao Zuo's face, "Your little life, as well as the god-level techniques, will all be mine!"
In the next moment, he took out the letter of jade card and gave instructions for a while, then flew out of the aura airship and hurried towards the city.
at the same time.
In Eastern City, an unprecedented robbery is underway!

chapters.title: Chapter 207: The four characters have no enmity
paragraphs: There is no Dange.
This is a Dan Pavilion that was acquired by Ji's family, and the management members are all Ji's seniors.
This Dan Pavilion is much larger than the Jingxin Dan Tower!
And here, it is more lively than the Meditation Pill Building.
However, that was all a few minutes ago.
At this moment, the whole altar pavilion is completely silent, and the needle drop can be heard!
Because almost everyone ran away, leaving only a few members of the Ji family.
Usually, these members of the Ji family can be described as arrogant and domineering, doing whatever they want.
But at this time, they all looked desperate, trembling all over, almost peeing out.
"Did you take me to the secret library, or did I kill you and find it myself?"
A man wrapped in a black robe said slowly.
This person is the clone controlled by Su Lang with a perfect lean.
"Big...sir!"
An elderly member of the Ji family tremblingly said, "Please don't kill us! We will take you there!"
In the face of the great horror between life and death, nothing is more important than life-saving.
Therefore, these Ji family members agreed without hesitation.
"Hmph, count your acquaintances."
Su Lang hummed lightly, "Lead the way, don't play tricks, or you will die miserably."
"Big...sir, we dare not!"
The old man of the Ji family shook his head in fear, and then tremblingly pointed to a certain direction of the Dan Pavilion, "My lord, the secret library is over there, please follow us..."
Therefore, under the leadership of several members of the Ji family, Su Lang successfully entered the Wuyou Dange secret library.
A large number of pill bottles are stored in white jade boxes one by one.
There are thousands of boxes containing the stock of elixir alone!
And there are even more things in the material secret library, from F-level to A-level materials!
In addition, there is also a secret vault dedicated to storing funds, which is neatly stacked with spiritual stones and gold coins as high as a mountain.
"Tsk tsk, Ji family is so fat!"
Su Lang screamed, and put all these things into the storage space!
"Goooo!"
A member of the Ji family swallowed hard and said nervously, "Big...sir, I...may we...go away?"
"You can go."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "However, you have to leave something before you can leave."
These Ji family members can control Wuyou Dan Pavilion, and naturally they are all Ji Ge's confidants.
Su Lang wouldn't just let them go!
"Huh...huh?"
The old man fell to the ground with fear, "My lord...you said you wouldn't kill us!"
"I didn't say I would kill you."
Su Lang sneered, "You guys, you only need to leave a solid foundation!"
With that said, Su Lang didn't wait for a few members of the Ji family to beg for mercy, hit a few auras between his fingers, and directly smashed their Dantian!
"what--!!"
"No! My cultivation base!
Several members of the Ji family burst into tears and wailed constantly, tumbling painfully on the ground like shrimps!
"Hmph, I didn't kill you, it's already merciful."
Su Lang hummed coldly, and immediately moved his wrist, leaving four characters on the wall.
-There is no hatred in the world!
If you don't kill your enemies, you will never give up!
At the same time, Xinglong Danfang and Jijia Danlou also staged such a scene.
However, compared with Wuyou Dange, the resistance of these two families is stronger.
Especially in Jijiadan Tower, there is an elder of the Wuwang level guarding it.
Of course, Su Lang directly killed two Wu Kings on the Aura Airship.
The Wu Wang of a Ji family is naturally not immune to him!
Therefore, in just a few minutes, all the funds, pills and materials of Jijia Danlou and Xinglong Danfang fell into Su Lang's hands!
In such a short period of time, neither the King of the Martial Arts Alliance who was searching for the trail of Su Lang nor the King of the Ji family could provide immediate support.
When they rushed to the three Dange Danfang in a hurry, Su Lang had already taken back his clone!
And at this moment, Juewu Mountain.
Ji Ge is sitting opposite a middle-aged man.
This middle-aged man was thin, with sword eyebrows and star-eyed eyes, and his expression was stern.
And this person is exactly Ren Tianfeng who came to Dongfang City to hold Xuanyuan Budo Academy enrollment!

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Unrestrained
paragraphs: "Master Ren."
"This is the good tea Golden Guanyin I brought back from Xilan City, try it!"
Ji Ge said with a smile, but from the bottom of his eyes, he could still see some sadness.
After all, his son only died one day.
However, the other party was a member of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, and he was also a Wuhuang expert, so he had to personally receive it.
"Thank you Patriarch Ji."

Ji Ge squeezed a smile, "If you have any needs, just say it.

"Then I'll be straight."
Ren Tianfeng smiled and nodded, "Patriarch Ji also knows that I'm here to recruit students for Xuanyuan Wudao Academy.

Recently, the enrollment date is getting closer and closer, and I plan to start arranging the Yuelong Array.

Therefore, I would like to borrow your Ji family’s precious land for use and return it after enrollment. "
"Master Ren, you have to borrow Jue Wushan, of course it will be fine."
"Our Juewu Mountain can become the enrollment place of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, it is our honor!"
Ji Ge looked at Ren Tianfeng with a smile, "My lord, I will let all the people on Juewu Mountain leave and clean them up again."
Juewu Mountain is the only huge natural mountain in Dongfang City.
It was the Ji family who insisted on keeping it at the beginning and stayed, otherwise it would have been dug up to build a building.
And now, this natural mountain is extremely rare and cherished in the steel jungle-like Eastern City.
However, no matter how cherished it is, it is just a mountain, nothing more than some natural scenery.
Now that it can be used as an enrollment place for Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, Ji Ge is eager.
"Hahahaha, then thank Patriarch Ji too much."
Ren Tianfeng laughed, and immediately stood up, "Then I will wait for Patriarch Ji to deal with this matter about Wushan, and then I will find Patriarch Ji for tea."
"Okay, next time I will prepare more precious tea!"
Ji Ge knew that Ren Tianfeng was a vigorous man, so he didn't plan to stay.
With that said, Ji Ge wanted to send Ren Tianfeng away.
But at this moment.
Suddenly, the jade card of his transmission flickered.
Ji Ge's face changed, revealing some joy.
"It seems that guard Cao Zuo caught the Su Lang thief!"
Ren Tianfeng couldn't help laughing when he saw Ji Ge's face suddenly delighted.
He naturally knew what Su Lang did in Dongfang City.
However, it is not easy for Ren Tianfeng to intervene in this matter.
After all, this is an internal matter within Eastern City, and Cao Zuo will take care of it.
And he is an outsider, and if he rashly does it, he will be suspicious of being overwhelmed.
"I've told me before, except for Su Lang's children, nothing else can disturb me.
Now there is news that Su Lang was caught by Cao Zuo's guard.
Haha, he escaped in an aura airship, how could his speed escape the chase of Cao Zuo's guard? "
Ji Ge said with a smile, "Let me see if he has been taken back to Dongfang City by Cao Zuozhen now.
If he comes back, I must go to torture him severely, so I can relieve the hatred! "
With that said, Ji Ge took out the jade card of Chuanxin.
But when he saw the message on the Chuanxin Jade Plate clearly, the joy on his face instantly solidified!
"What's wrong? Patriarch Ji?"
Ren Tian sealed the secret path and used his mental power to sweep away the jade card, and his complexion suddenly changed!
I saw a few words on the Chuanxin jade card:
"Master Patriarch, Su Lang reappears in the Eastern City!
He is retaliating against Master Cao Zuo and our Ji family.
Xinglong Danfang, Jijia Danlou and Wuyou Dange were looted at the same time.
Sixth elder Ji Long died, and the other important members also suffered heavy casualties!
Moreover, Su Lang was extremely rampant, and when he fled, he left behind the four characters "The World Without Enmity"! "
"There is no hatred in the world!!"
"This is meant to cut all enemies into extinction!"
After reading the information, Ren Tianfeng couldn't help showing horror, "This Su Lang is really unruly and arrogant!"
When Ren Tianfeng was surprised, the solidified joy on Ji Ge's face quickly turned into endless anger and resentment!

"Master Ren!"
"If you can make a move, that would be great!"
"I will send a message to Master Cao Zuo immediately, I believe Master Cao Zuo will never refuse!"

"Great! Master Cao Zuo welcomes Master Ren very much!"

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Spirit level breakthrough!
paragraphs: "Ding! Gold coins and spirit stones have all been deposited into the system!"
With the notification of the system, in the mysterious black space, the balance of medium-grade spirit stones soared to 3,989,965!
"Hey!"
"It's close to four million middle-grade spirit stones, which is really cool!"
Su Lang's eyes showed excitement, but he did not immediately upgrade the system functions.
At present, the funds required for one-click training and one-click martial arts upgrades are insufficient.
But one-key treasure hunting and one-key alchemy do not increase combat power much, and it doesn’t matter if you upgrade later.
On the contrary, the clone dispatch is about to be level 10, and once you upgrade, you can definitely get the most benefit.
So Su Lang intends to save a wave!
"The top priority is to raise the level of mental power first."
Su Lang smiled, and cast his gaze on the alchemy materials in the storage space.
After robbing the three largest pill shops in Dongfang City, Wang-level alchemy materials are naturally indispensable.
After checking, Su Lang found that the materials he possessed could not only refine Shenji Locking Heart Pill, but also a better high-level king-rank pill—Tianxin Jingwu Pill!
"Haha, that's great!"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised, "The system, immediately refine the Shenji Suoxin Pill and Tianxin Jingwu Pill for me!"
Give an order.
The materials in the storage space disappeared one by one.
In the mysterious black space, the pill furnace in the hands of the alchemy villain began to run wildly!
"Ding! Successful refining, you will get Shenji Heart Locking Pill*5"
"Ding! Successful refining, you will get Shenji Heart Locking Pill*5"
"Ding! Successful refining, you will get Tianxin Jingwu Pill*5
"Ding! Successfully refined,..."
Listening to the constantly ringing system prompts, Su Lang was very excited.
After a while, the continuous system prompts finally disappeared.
In the storage space, dozens of Shenji Suoxin Pill and Tianxin Jingwu Pill lay quietly there.
"Tsk tusk, so many pills are enough to upgrade my spirit level!"
Su Lang let out excitement, and immediately took out all the pills.
In an instant, the entire underground building was filled with Danxiang.
"Wow! It smells so good!"
"What kind of pill is it? Just smelling it makes me feel refreshed!"
Murong Xianxian and Ji Ruxue followed Danxiang to look at them, and then immediately showed shock.
"These medicinal pills... are all Wang-rank medicinal pills, more than 30 pill!"
"Moreover, all of them are Wang-rank pills that enhance mental power!"
Murong Xianxian stared at her beautiful eyes, and the surprise on her small face was hard to conceal.
"Don't be so shocked, it's just some pills."
Su Lang smiled faintly, then one after another, stuffed all the pills into his mouth, and ate it with a chirp.
Seeing this scene, Murong Xianxian and Ji Ruxue fell into sluggishness.
It’s too extravagant to consume so much of the perfect quality Wang-rank pill!
After eating the pill.
Su Lang felt that his mind became clearer, and the amount and intensity of his mental power began to increase rapidly.
Close your eyes and sink your mind into the sea of knowledge.
Su Lang discovered that the thousands of silk ribbons near the white halo had almost doubled tenfold!
These thousands of silk ribbons continue to pour into the white halo, making it even brighter!
After about ten minutes.
A trace of gold condensed in the center of the white halo, which looked very strange!
And at this moment.
"Ding! The spirit level can be broken, can it be broken immediately?"
"Break immediately!"
As soon as the system prompt sounded, Su Lang chose to break through without hesitation.
next moment!
I saw that the golden halo in the middle of the white halo became more and more, and immediately condensed together to form a continuously circulating golden gauze mist!
"The spiritual level of the Ningwu realm is complete!"
Su Lang opened his eyes fiercely, and two terrifying lights shot out, frightening Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian in surprise.
Then, something even stranger happened.
I saw some small objects in the room floating out of thin air!
"Spiritual treasure!"
Murong Xianxian said in surprise, "Master Su Lang's mental power has reached the level that it can interfere with reality, so amazing!"
"The mental strength to interfere with reality!"
Ji Ruxue was also shocked, "This is the spiritual fogging realm that Emperor Wu can reach. Brother Su Lang is so strong!"

Su Lang smiled faintly, and withdrew his mental power, all the small objects floating around immediately fell to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 212: Ten-level avatar dispatch function!
paragraphs: Inside the Oriental City.
Su Lang's clone is looting frantically.
Cao Zuo and Ji's major shops completely gave up resistance.
As soon as Su Lang's avatar showed up and revealed his aura, the other party obediently handed over everything.
Within a few minutes, Su Lang looted eight fat stores.
Among them, the most loot was obtained from the weapon shop, and he even harvested two junior king weapons.
Su Lang did not hesitate to equip the clone!
At the same time, he also found abnormalities in these shops.
"All gave up resistance?"
"It makes sense for one family to give up resistance, and eight families give up at the same time..."
Su Lang raised his brows, "It is estimated that Cao Zuo and Ji's family gave the order. Is this a sign of weakness, or is there another plan?"
After a while of doubt, Su Lang gave up guessing.
Anyway, waiting for the strength to improve, let him and Cao Zuo and others play flowers, it is just a chicken!
"Look at how many spirit stones there are already?"
Su Lang licked his lips with excitement, "System, deposit all the gold coins and spirit stones!"
"Ding! All gold coins and spirit stones have been deposited in the system!"
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang watched the spirit stone balance skyrocket, and finally reached the terrifying eight-digit number-11238968!
"Haha, over 11 million middle-grade spirit stones!"
Su Lang grinned and immediately ordered, "The system, upgrade the one-click treasure hunt function and the clone dispatch function!

"Ding! Consumption of 1 million middle-grade spirit stones, the one-click treasure hunting function has been upgraded to level 9, and the number of treasure hunting flying flying gliders has increased to 512!"
"Ding! Consume 10 million middle-grade spirit stones, the clone dispatch function is upgraded to level 10, the number of clones is +1, and the current number of clones is 10!"
"Ding! Congratulations on upgrading the clone dispatch function to level 10. You have obtained the new bonus functions ‘Clone Replacement’ and ‘Medium Wisdom’!"
After the wonderful system prompts, a series of information was instilled into Su Lang's mind.
Soon, Su Lang understood the function of the two bonus functions, which made him instantly excited.
Among them, the ‘medium spiritual intelligence’ gives the clone more complex thinking.
This allows the clone to execute more complex instructions and communicate with life simply.
"Hey, you can!"
"With medium intelligence, when the clone executes orders, it can be more accurate!"
Su Lang frowned and smiled, very satisfied with this feature.
However, this feature is far worse than ‘Clone Replace’!
Because the role of clone replacement is to exchange positions with the selected clone in 0.1 second!
This feature is extremely abnormal!
With the clone replacement, it is equivalent to having eight mobile teleportation arrays!
Where you want to go, you only need to dispatch the clone to the destination and exchange locations again!
In addition, this is an extremely powerful life-saving skill.
If Su Lang encounters an overwhelming danger, he can exchange positions with the clone and escape the danger by just holding for 0.1 second!
It can be said that as long as the safety of this 0.1 second can be guaranteed, it is equivalent to how many clones there are, and there are as many lives as Su Lang!
"My fork, this function is not weaker than the swallowing clone!"
"It's worthy of a 10th level gift function, it's awesome!"
Su Lang couldn't help letting out a deep and excited laugh, "Hey, with the clone replacement, I can get more waves!"
"Oh...Brother Su Lang..."
Seeing that Su Lang started to giggle again, Ji Ruxue couldn't help but sighed, and by the way also told Murong Xianxian about Su Lang's little problem.
at the same time.
Under the impetus of the three of Cao Zuo, a shocking news spread throughout Dongfang City!
And this news is that the people who have been robbing and killing people in recent days are the foreign life that invaded Blue Star, the remnants of the Wind Spirit Race!
As soon as the news spread, it immediately swept the audience like a hurricane and tsunami.
Almost everyone felt that the sky was falling!
"My goodness!"
"The remnants of the Wind Spirit Race are in our Eastern City!"
"If there is no stimulus to the Wind Spirit Race, it all represents a cruel war that is almost annihilating the city. Is it possible that our Eastern City will be over?"
"No! I'm not an adult, I haven't enjoyed the happiest thing in the world!"
"Run away, while the Wind Spirit Race hasn't manipulated the beast tide to attack Eastern City, let's run away!"
"Right, right, right! Let's go to the airport, we take the airship to other cities!"

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Cao Zuo's stupid way
paragraphs: Countless people are as terrified and desperate as the end is coming.
Immediately, a large number of people packed their belongings and rushed towards the airport.
However, when they arrived at the airport, they found that the airport was completely closed!
Someone got into the airport to check and found that even the energy of the Aura airship had been removed!
Moreover, the mountain-like barriers of Eastern City gradually lit up!
A layer of light covering the sky and sun shrouded the entire Eastern City!
"Do not!!"
"We can't leave Dongfang City! It's over!"
"As soon as the barrier shield is opened, it almost means that the tide of fierce beasts is coming. What should we do!?"
All the people complained and wailed, and some even began to curse Cao Zuo, the guard.
And just now!
In the center of Eastern City, three black dots gradually rose to the sky.
These three black spots are the three martial emperors Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan, and Ren Tianfeng!
"Everyone is listening!"
Cao Zuo's voice was not loud, but it spread to most of the Eastern City, "The remnants of the Wind Spirit Clan are not as powerful as you think.
He is already a turtle in the urn, and we will catch him sooner or later! "
"Not bad!"
Ji Yuan went on to say, "The reason why the airport is closed and the barrier is opened is to prevent the remnants of the Fengling tribe from escaping.
We promise that we will seize the remnants of the Fengling tribe as soon as possible, put them to death, and return the Eastern City to peace!
"the above!"
Ren Tianfeng said, "I, the admissions tutor of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, the main city of Blue Star, Ren Tianfeng, can testify!"
The words of the three spread all over Dongfang City and immediately caused a sensation!
"It turns out to be a remnant of the Wind Spirit Clan who is not too strong!"
"Yes! The guardian Cao Zuo dares to chase and kill this remnant, it means that Dongfang City has the strength to kill it."
"Huh! What a false alarm, it scared me to death!"
"Great, great! Let's go, let's go back!"
Countless people are talking about going back home.
But at this time, Cao Zuo spoke again: "Now, to make it easier to search for the remnants of the Fengling clan.
All people in the Oriental City, no matter what their identities, all have to go to the Oriental City Plaza for inspection.
Violators, kill without mercy! ! "
Murderous voices spread across the streets and alleys of Dongfang City, everyone was frightened!
Immediately, everyone in the Oriental City began to pack their bags and headed to Oriental Plaza.
In a short period of time, a large number of high-rise buildings were empty, and the streets were empty.
Immediately afterwards, a large number of people were dispatched to conduct the most thorough inspection on those who arrived at the Oriental City Plaza.
No matter what their identity is, they must be checked.
at the same time.
From the Oriental City Branch of the Warrior Alliance, Ji's family, and the other five Oriental City King Wu Clan, the King Wu was dispatched.
28 people in total!
These Wu Kings flew up into the sky, starting from the fortress barrier, and carrying out a carpet search with spiritual perception.
A total of 28 Wu Kings were scattered, and there were seven Wu Kings in every direction!
Their huge aura overwhelmed the sky and almost made the sky gloomy.
At the same time, there were a large number of military commanders searching on the ground. Everyone carried the jade plaque, and once there was an abnormality, they could be alerted immediately.
"Oh my God!"
"All Martial Kings and Martial Kings in our Eastern City are dispatched!"
"The last time there was such a big battle was when there was a wave of fierce beasts seven years ago!"
"In order to catch the remnants of this Fengling Clan, Master Cao Zuo is really cruel!"
"This Fengling clan dares to make trouble in our Dongfang City. It's really deadly."
"Yes, I must go up and spit when Master Cao Zuo catches him!"
In Dongfang City, almost everyone was angry, discussing and cursing passionately.
However, they had no idea that it was all Cao Zuo's lies.
The other side.
Such a big change naturally couldn't hide from Su Lang's eyes and ears.
"Even drove everyone to a pile for inspection and started a carpet search?"
Su Lang smiled in surprise, "How can such a stupid method be used?
However, although this method is a bit stupid, it is really useful for ordinary people.
It's a pity that to me, it's still not worth mentioning, even... it's asking for trouble! "

Their rear, there is no more empty time than this time!
"Humph!"
"I hope you have enough wealth!"
A sneer appeared at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "My one-click treasure hunting function is already level 9 too!"
In the next moment, Su Lang dispatched all the nine clones!
In the Ji family mansion, a Su Lang clone appeared directly in the courtyard that had been burnt down.
At this moment, the entire Ji family was almost empty.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang cloned his mental perception and began to search for the location of Ji's secret library!
This is the benefit brought by the ‘medium spiritual intelligence’.
If it was before, Su Lang would still need to use ‘perfect leaning’ to achieve this.
The clone possessing a medium-level sapience unfolded the fog-condensing level of mental power, and soon locked several abnormal places.
Some are made of hard materials.
In some places, the spiritual perception swept away into nothingness.
In some places, there were three military commanders guarding them, and they knew something was wrong.
"Humph!"
The avatar of Su Lang hummed faintly, moving towards the place guarded by the three military commanders.
The three Ji's martial artists are guarding a gate attentively.
Immediately after their eyes flashed, they realized that there was a young figure in front of them!
"who are you!?"
"Why are you here!?"
"Quickly, you...who are you!?"
The three Ji's martial artists looked nervous, their voices trembled, and they were a little scared!
This is one of Ji's secret library!
Who could come here quietly?
"Open the door!"
Su Lang's avatar took off his mask, his voice indifferent.
"It's you!"
"You are Su Lang!"
"You are here!?"
The three Jijia Wushu commanders saw the face of Su Lang's avatar, and instantly lost their voices in horror!
"Open the door!"
Su Lang said coldly, "Otherwise, you will be killed!"
While speaking, the Wu Wang-class breath and terrifying killing intent directly enveloped the three military commanders.
The three Ji Jiawu commanders stood upside down in an instant, their hairs horrified, and their pupils shrunk to the same size as mung beans!
"Say it again."
"Open the door, otherwise there will be no mercy!"
The avatar of Su Lang stepped forward, and an unsheathed golden long sword appeared in his hand.
"It is the king of the Six Elders!"
The three Ji's military commanders were almost gone, and one of them immediately fell to the ground!
"You guys, don't understand me!"
Su Lang's avatar waved with one hand, and the three Ji's martial arts commanders had no time to beg for mercy, and they were in different places!
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang's avatar slashed at the thick gate, and a loud bang like a bronze bell spread directly throughout the Ji family mansion!
In addition, a large number of formations appeared on the gate, and its defenses were terrifying.
However, Su Lang's avatar has an attack level of Advanced Martial King +, and coupled with the king weapon in his hand, the attack power that bursts out has reached the peak Martial King level!
The strongest of the Ji family is just the junior martial emperor Ji Yuan. How strong can their secret vault formations be?
Before long, Su Lang's clone broke the formation and opened the door!
"boom!"
The door was shattered, and a lot of precious light shone out, almost dazzling people's eyes!
Su Lang did not hesitate to take it all, and then went to the next place.
The same thing happened not only in Ji's mansion.
There are also the mansions of the Cao family, as well as the individual Wu Wang family who have been in the same style with the Ji family and the Cao family!
Almost all of these places left martial-arts-level guards, and there was more than a wave of fighting.
Therefore, Cao Zuo and others soon discovered that Su Lang appeared in nine places at the same time! !

"boom!"

chapters.title: Chapter 215: How to explain this
paragraphs: "Nine Su Langs!?"
"He has as many as eight clones!? How could this be possible!?"
"Oh my God, this is not true, it is definitely not true!"
The three Cao Zuo looked at each other, their faces filled with disbelief.

"Eight clones are absolutely impossible, even a god-level technique can't do it!"
Cao Zuo said solemnly, "The only explanation is that these people are not his clones, but subordinates who pretend to be his clones!"
"Not bad!"
"Now that the space confinement formation has been activated, he can't use teleportation to move around nine places, creating the illusion of having eight clones."
Ji Yuan also had a firm face, "These people who do it are definitely Su Lang's subordinates, or accomplices.
And he himself, perhaps hiding among these nine people, or hiding alone in the dark, trying to create chaos and escape. "
"This Su Lang is really cunning!"
"However, no matter how they toss, they are all turtles in the urn."
The solemn expression on Cao Zuo's face turned into a sneer, "Let him toss himself.
We continue the previous plan, compress their range of activities, and then sack them in one fell swoop!
When the time comes, the wealth he robbed will return to our hands. "
"Well, give it an order."
Ren Tianfeng said lightly, "Don't let your subordinates panic."
"it is good!"
Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan showed cold smiles.

Slums, underground buildings.
"Oh? The old nest was robbed by me, so I was indifferent?"

"Do not!

Ji Yuan felt that his eyebrows were beating wildly, which was hard to restrain.
"Perhaps a secret method to increase speed was used."
Ren Tianfeng on the side suddenly said, "I have seen many Wuwang-level geniuses in the main city of Blue Star. If they use special secret methods, they can do this too."
"That should be the case!"
Cao Zuo nodded suddenly, "They must have used the secret method to increase speed!"
"In that case..."
Ji Yuan breathed a sigh of relief, "Then let the subordinates don't panic and continue searching!"
"Ok!"

"what!?"
"Su Lang has started the third round of looting!? And..."

"exactly!"

at the same time.

"The system, send me all the treasure hunt flying gliders out for treasure hunt!"

"Su Lang remnant, show up immediately, otherwise we will kill your comrades!"
"Su Lang remnant, you don't want the people in the Meditation Danlou, Ji Ruxue, and Granny Ke's relatives and friends to die, just show up immediately!"
"Lying down!
The corners of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "A magnificent martial emperor-level powerhouse, how can he do such a nasty thing?"
At this time, the voice grew louder and louder, and Ji Ruxue, Murong Xianxian and Granny Ke also heard them.
"Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue was shocked, "What should we do?"
"Master Su Lang..."
Murong Xianxian also looked at Su Lang in panic.
As the host of the Jingxin Pill, she really doesn't want the people in the Jingxin Pill to die.
"Don't worry, don't they just want me out?"
Su Lang rubbed Ji Ruxue's head and smiled, "It's a big deal, I'm going out now to see the trash that I played around with."
Murong Xianxian showed concern, "Master Su Lang, they have Emperor Wu!"
"Emperor Wu is nothing but can't kill me."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "You are here waiting for me, I will meet them.
By the way, you don't have to worry about your safety, my clone will protect you at any time. "
While talking, Su Lang directly dispatched a clone to the vicinity of Oriental City Square.
Immediately after.
"Clone replacement!"
Su Lang thought, and exchanged positions with the clone.
The scene of the original underground room turned into a small alley.
"Su Lang remnant!"
"Appear immediately, or we will kill your comrades one by one!"
The penetrating sound still continued.

This person is Ren Tianfeng!

paragraphs: "Awesome, it turned out to be a perfect qualification!"
"Moreover, I have practiced the three king-level exercises to the Dacheng level!"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, "You deserve to be from the main city of Blue Star, and you deserve to be the tutor of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy!

With a sneer, Su Lang directly released his vigorous aura.
"boom!"

"This breath is not from any of our martial kings!"
"I feel a bit of fighting aura left by Su Lang, very similar to this aura!"
"It seems that Su Lang really came out, hahahaha!"
Cao Zuo and others were ecstatic.
How miserable they were being played before, but now they got back a little bit, of course they exhale.
And at this moment.
When Su Lang moved, he reached the top of a building on the edge of Oriental Plaza within a few breaths.
Looking down from here, you can see the densely packed Dongfangcheng warriors.
They are bustling, shoulder to shoulder, almost forming a sea of people.
"Su Lang child, you finally appeared!
When Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan saw Su Lang's figure, their expressions were grim and resentment.
They rose from the ground and flew to a short distance from Su Lang, slamming Su Lang in the middle one after another.
Ren Tianfeng stayed in place to guard the people who threatened Su Lang.
The other King Wu also came quickly from a distance, forming a huge encirclement on the periphery.
At the same time, countless warriors in the square also saw Su Lang, and there was an uproar immediately.
"Is the wind spirit tribe's remnant he?"
"Looks so young, not even twenty years old!"
"At such a young age, it is incredible to be able to confront Master Cao Zuo and Master Ji Yuan!"
"He is the remnant of the Fengling Clan, you don't know how abnormal the Fengling Clan is, they are official warriors from birth!"
"But, I don't think this Su Lang is like the Wind Spirit Clan. Isn't the Wind Spirit Clan with snow hair, handsome as a monster, and beautiful as a fairy?
Although this Su Lang is also very handsome, he doesn't have any snowy hair! "
"You stupid, doesn't he know how to dye his hair? If you are a Fengling clan, would you dare to sway in the Eastern City with a snowy hair?"
"Oh, it turned out to be like this..."
"Huh, the disguise of Su Lang's remnant is very good, but unfortunately, I still can't hide it from the master Cao Zuo who is aware of the details!"
"Yes, yes, today is his death date, I wish I could slash him!"
Countless warriors talked about it, and the entire square was like a boiling pot.
However, Su Lang turned a deaf ear to their comments.
Some weak people who have been blinded by lies are just too lazy to care.
At this time, he was viewing the attribute panel of Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan.
Compared with Ren Tianfeng, the strength of Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan is far behind.
Both of them could only explode the fighting power of the Intermediate Martial Sovereign, Su Lang dismissed it at all.
"Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan."
"As you wished, I showed up."
Su Lang looked at Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan with a sneer in his eyes, "I didn't expect you to be able to do such a nasty thing."
"Huh! Haven't you done it to threaten this kind of thing?"
Ji Yuan's eyes were as cold as ice, "Just yesterday, you used my grandson's life to force my Ji family to hand over 500 billion gold coins. Did you forget?"
"Hey, is Ji Wubo innocent?"
"He personally killed Ji Ruxue's mother, sister with a different surname, and others. He was originally my enemy and Ji Ruxue."
"There is nothing wrong with me using him to threaten you. On the contrary, this is a chance I gave him to survive, but you are cruel and unwilling to save him."
Su Lang smiled calmly, "Look at the person you used to threaten me, which one is not innocent?"
"innocent!?"
"If you are involved with Ji Ruxue, it is the remnant of the Fengling Race!"
Ji Yuan gritted his teeth and said, "For the remnants of the Fengling Clan, we should be wiped out. Even if it is my Ji family, I will kill my relatives righteously!"

paragraphs: "Good! Good, well said!"

"Master Ji Yuan understands righteousness and kills the remnants of the Fengling Clan, Su Lang, and Ji Ruxue!"

Could it be that you haven’t had enough of the Cao Jiaji’s monopoly of all industries in Oriental City and endless exploitation and exploitation of you? "

"Su Lang child!"

Ji Yuan's face was ashen and gloomy as water, "What you said is nothing but nothing!"
"Ha ha!"

Wait a minute, I must slap you 10,000 slaps and recast your face. "
"Huh! Su Lang child, you do have some tricks!"
"Even you standing in front of us are not sure if it is your deity."
Cao Zuo hummed heavily and sneered, "However, the initiative is in our hands.
You have to see the situation clearly!
Now, I want to see your deity, all your subordinates and clones, otherwise we will kill those people immediately!
As soon as Cao Zuo's voice fell, Ren Tian's cover faded, and he was very cooperative and exuded a trace of murderous aura.

"Hehe, the instructor of the dignified Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, he is really complacent and complacent with people like Cao Zuo Jiyuan."

"Humph!"
Ren Tianfeng snorted coldly, "For the remnants of the Fengling Clan, I would rather kill the mistake than let it go!
However, if you bring your avatar and subordinates to capture, we can consider letting go of these less suspected people. "
"Yes, you don't want to play any tricks."
Cao Zuo's complexion became more and more ferocious, "Within five minutes, your deity, all your subordinates, and clones must be arrested!
Of course, you can also choose to give up the remnants below, but even so, you still can't escape from Eastern City.
Now you are the remnant of the Fengling Clan, and the entire Blue Star has no place for you!
As soon as the support of the Blue Star main city arrives, if you use your means to reach the sky, you will undoubtedly die! "
"Tsk tusk, I'm so scared!"

"Su Lang child, no matter how weird you are, you are only a martial king!"
Ji Yuan looked down at Su Lang and sneered, "Mental attacks are ineffective against you. Can you still resist our physical attacks and attribute attacks?
In front of us, you can only flee like a rat, wanting to kill us, what a dream! "
"Is it?"

Such a scene is almost like the end of the day!

at the same time.

Su Lang turned to look at Ren Tianfeng, his eyes full of contempt.
"Humph!"
Ren Tianfeng snorted coldly, "For the remnants of the Fengling Clan, I would rather kill the mistake than let it go!
However, if you bring your avatar and subordinates to capture, we can consider letting go of these less suspected people.
"Yes, you don't want to play any tricks."
Cao Zuo's complexion became more and more ferocious, "Within five minutes, your deity, all your subordinates, and clones must be arrested!
Of course, you can also choose to give up the remnants below, but even so, you still can't escape from Eastern City.
Now you are the remnant of the Fengling Clan, and the entire Blue Star has no place for you!
As soon as the support of the Blue Star main city arrives, if you use your means to reach the sky, you will undoubtedly die!
"Tsk tusk, I'm so scared!"
There was a touch of playfulness and sarcasm on Su Lang's face, "Unfortunately, you can't kill anyone today, nor can you trap me, because you all have to die!"
"Hahaha, what a shame!"
"Su Lang child, no matter how weird you are, you are only a martial king!"
Ji Yuan looked down at Su Lang and sneered, "Mental attacks are ineffective against you.
Can you still resist our physical attacks and attribute attacks?
In front of us, you can only flee like a rat, wanting to kill us, what a dream!
"Is it?"
"Then let you see if I am dreaming!!"
A terrifying murderous aura erupted from Su Lang's body, and the warriors in the entire Dongfang City were terrified, and their scalps were about to explode.
Immediately afterwards, Su Lang sneered and wanted to use the final hole card-Devouring the clone!
But at this moment!
"Boom!"
The entire Dongfang City suddenly went dark, and endless thunderclouds rolled endlessly, pressing down fiercely.
The terrifying thundercloud is like a hundred-level tsunami hanging upside down, and the huge Eastern City is like a big ship about to capsize!
Such a scene is almost like the end of the day!
This sudden change made everyone thunderous and stunned!
In the next moment, on the Oriental City Square, countless warriors began to scream and flee in panic!
The chaos spread in an instant, I don't know how many warriors were trampled to death alive!
at the same time.
The expressions of Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan, and Ren Tianfeng also changed drastically!
Because this kind of heaven and earth vision represents the tide of fierce beasts!
"Just, why isn't there a warning beam?"
Su Lang also looked out of the city with some surprise, but found that there was no sight of hundreds of beams of light rising into the sky when the beast tide of Red Maple City came.
In other words, there is no wave of fierce beasts outside the city!
So...what the is going on! ?

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Feng Lingwu God Tu Qinzheng!
paragraphs: Just as he was uncertain, Su Lang suddenly looked up with feeling.
I saw a terrifying crack in the billowing thundercloud!
This crack is incompatible with the whole world, just like it was up with the worst PS method!
"This is...a crack in time and space!!"
"How could this happen, how could the cracks in time and space appear in Dongfang City!?"
Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan and Ren Tianfeng exclaimed at the same time, their faces full of fear!
Every crack in time and space represents a passage for the Wind Spirit to the Blue Star, and also represents destruction and death!
"A crack in time and space... This feeling is really chilling!"
Su Lang looked at the time-space crack hanging in the sky, and instinctively had a strong sense of crisis.
at this time.
The space-time crack hanging in the air suddenly opened like a giant beast's mouth
An incomparable horror, an incomparably vast breath descended on the earth!
In an instant, the whole audience was completely silent, and everyone seemed to be stiff, with a dull complexion stuck in place, like a sculpture.
The entire Eastern City seemed to be under the control of Death!
"This breath...this is..."
Ren Tianfeng's eyes violently burst, and his body trembled, "Wu... Valkyrie-level aura!!"
"Above Wu Zun——War God!!"
Cao Zuo and Ji Yuan lost their voices in horror, and showed despair!
Su Lang was also shocked, even if he used the swallowing clone hole card, he was completely insignificant in front of the Valkyrie!
At this time!
"Blue Star, long time no see!"
A slight murmur spread all over the world!
Immediately afterwards, a giant wolf-shaped beast that covered the sky and the sun stuck out its head from the crack in the space.
And on its head, sitting cross-legged was a handsome man with flying snowy hair.
This person is the Valkyrie-class Wind Spirit Race!
And the giant wolf under his seat is also a terrifying martial arts-class beast!
With the appearance of these two, the breath of incomparable vastness became stronger.
Countless people on the Oriental City Square were crushed to their knees!
And this is still under the protection of the barrier defense formation.
If there were no barriers to protect, those weak warriors could not even bear this breath, and they would be crushed to death.
"Lie noisy, this is too strong!"
Seeing the Valkyrie-level Wind Spirit clan man riding a giant wolf, Su Lang was shocked, and soon called up his attribute panel.
"Properties panel!"
[Name]: Tu Qinzheng
[Race]: Wind Spirit
[Qualification level]: No shortage
[Realm level]: Elementary Valkyrie
[Attack level]: Intermediate Valkyrie+
[Defensive level]: Junior Valkyrie
[Shenfa level]: Intermediate Valkyrie
[Endurance Level]: Junior Valkyrie
[Spirit Level]: Morning Star Realm
[Master the exercises]: Infinite Heart Sutra, Qing Huibao Sutra (God level, Dacheng) Hanxiang Cangyu Xuandian (God level, Xiaocheng)
"hiss--!!"
Looking at this attribute panel, Su Lang couldn't help but breathe in cold air.
At the same time, he also found some useful information.
"It turns out that the spiritual level above the sea of mind is the Morning Star Realm!"
Su Lang's eyes widened, "Furthermore, the main practice of Fengling Clan's cultivation is also the Boundless Heart Sutra!
According to the history of the past two thousand years, the Boundless Heart Sutra should have originated from Blue Star.
Unexpectedly, the Fengling clan would also regard the Boundless Heart Sutra as the main practice, this practice is absolutely unusual! "
Thinking of this, Su Lang wanted to continue to observe Tu Qinzheng.
But at this time, as if feeling something, Tu Qinzheng's sudden gaze turned slightly and fell on Su Lang!
"I'm dying!"
Su Lang stood upside down with vellus hair all over his body, and his scalp was about to explode, so he did not hesitate to use ‘Clone Replace’!
After 0.1 second, Su Lang returned to the underground building of the slum, leaving a clone in the same place.
"Huh!? Interesting!"
Tu Qinzheng's coquettish eyes narrowed slightly.
With the Wushen level perception ability, he noticed the strangeness of that 0.1 second.
However, although he noticed it, he knew it but didn't know why, so it was a bit strange.
And just as he was looking at Su Lang's clone with great interest, he found that Su Lang's clone had faded and disappeared quickly!
"Unexpectedly, there should be such a weird human race on Blue Star, wait a moment to catch it and play."
Tu Qinzheng smiled faintly, then set his gaze on Dongfang City, "My daughter, I'm finally going to meet!"
As he spoke, he gently raised his hand and slammed his palm!

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Where is my daughter
paragraphs: Following the impression of Tu Qinzheng's palm, a huge palm covering the sky and the sun condensed and pressed towards Dongfang City like the sky fell!
In an instant, that terrifying palm was printed on the defensive formation of Dongfang City.
"boom!!"
A loud and deafening noise came out, and a nebula-like air wave swept away, distorting even the space!
However, the defensive array of Dongfang City suddenly burst into countless cobweb-like cracks.
The towering and majestic barrier of the mountain range suddenly cracked a lot of cracks.
At this moment, the sky is really dark, the sun and the moon are dark, and almost the entire world is about to be destroyed!
"It's over... it's over!!"
"The Oriental City must be over now!"
Cao Zuo's three martial emperors saw this scene, they were panicked, and their livers and gallbladders were splitting!
Those warriors under the cultivation base are even more frightened, and even scared to death on the spot.
Su Lang, hiding in the underground buildings of the slum, also shuddered.
If it weren't for Ji Ruxue and they were by their side, he would have used his clone to replace the Red Maple stronghold!
At the same time, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian were also extremely frightened, and they squeezed beside Su Lang.
"Brother Su Lang, what happened!?"
Ji Ruxue tightly grasped Su Lang's arm, her small white hands turned blue.
"Could it be that Cao Zuo and the others did it?"
Murong Xianxian was both worried and suspicious, "However, this breath can't be emitted by the Martial Emperor!
"It's really not Emperor Wu."
Su Lang took a deep breath and said, "It's... the Wind Spirit Race of the Warriors!"
"Wind Spirit Race!!"
Ji Ruxue, Murong Xianxian, and Granny Ke said in unbelievable high voices.
"Yes, there is a space-time crack in the sky."
Su Lang looked gloomy and said, "This Oriental City is probably going to be destroyed. There is only one word to survive, escape!"
"Run away!!"
"Master Cao Zuo, quickly open the city gates and barriers!"
"Nothing to save, no way to survive, flee!"
In the Oriental City Square, countless people began to flee, crying and crying.
The three of Cao Zuo also showed horror, and immediately turned and fled.
But at this moment!
"boom!!"
Tu Qin is taking another shot with a vicious palm.
It is also a big handprint covering the sky and the sun!
But this time, Dongfang City's defensive formation could no longer hold on, and the light shield shattered like glass.
Moreover, the thousands of meters of barriers inscribed with arrays also turned into dust and collapsed!
"Disperse and escape!!
Cao Zuo three people saw this scene, suddenly flew out of the city without life.
At the same time, in the underground buildings, Su Lang also witnessed all this through his clone.
Su Lang hugged Ji Ruxue in one hand and Murong Xianxian in the other, rushing out desperately.
Of course, he did not forget to send a clone to take Granny Ke away.
Within a short period of time, the Eastern City was full of warriors who were rushing for their lives in a disaster.
However, the Oriental City is too big!
Even Emperor Wu takes more than ten minutes to cross, where can those warriors escape?
Besides, Tu Qinzheng, who is high in the sky, didn't mean to let Dongfang City martial artist go.
"After finally opening a temporary passage, how can you let the human races go?"
Tu Qinzheng sneered, and immediately waved his big hand, a hurricane fell, forming a terrifying wind wall, covering all tens of miles of the Oriental City Square.
"Do not!!"
When Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan, and Ren Tianfeng saw that their way was broken, they immediately panicked and despaired!
Even the three major martial emperors were so desperate, and the rest of the martial artists were desperate, and helplessly stopped their escape.
By this time, tens of millions of people up and down Dongfang City, all of them gave up resistance, waiting for death to come.
However, Tu Qinzheng did not intend to kill them immediately.
"Look first, where is my daughter?"
Tu Qinzheng's eyes flashed, and a substantive spiritual force fell from the sky, covering a radius of 10,000 meters.
The horrible mental power was swept away one by one, and everyone who was checked felt cold from the outside to the inside, and couldn't help but feel even more desperate!
