chapters.title: Chapter 224: I forbid you to kill him!
paragraphs: For a while...
"what?"
"Not among these people?"
Tu Qinzheng was slightly surprised, "But based on the bloodline, my daughter is in this Eastern City. Could it be somewhere else in the city?"
Thinking of this, Tu Qinzheng would use his mental power to continue the search.
But at this moment, he suddenly discovered that two afterimages were fleeing quickly in the afterimages of his eyes!
These two afterimages are Su Lang holding Ji Ruxue, Murong Slim, and the clone with Granny Ke.
Because the slums were already near the edge of the barrier, at this moment, Su Lang had already reached the barrier and was about to escape outside the city.
"Familiar breath!"
Tu Qin's expression moved, his mental strength swept away, and his face immediately showed ecstasy!
"My blood! My daughter!"
"God, you really treat me not so badly, you really let me have descendants!"
Tu Qinzheng was really ecstatic. At his level, it was extremely difficult to give birth to offspring.
He tried various methods for hundreds of years, but he was unable to give birth to offspring.
At this time, it's hard to have a descendant. How does it make him unhappy? How not happy?
"Come back! My descendants!"
Tu Qinzheng smiled brightly and waved his big hand. An extremely powerful but very gentle wind directly encircled Su Lang and the clone.
"Like Nima!"
"There are so many people in the square, do you have to target us?"
Su Lang's eyes were violent, and he couldn't help but yell at him. Soon he didn't hesitate and immediately used the'Swallow Clone'!
In an instant, the eight clones suddenly disappeared!
"boom!!"
Su Lang suddenly burst out of a force far surpassing the Wuhuang level.
Before he could check the attribute panel, he immediately exploded with all his power and broke free from the whirlwind that Tu Qinzheng threw casually.
And this scene fell in the eyes of Tu Qinzheng, and immediately shocked him!
"This Human Race young man, obviously his cultivation level fluctuates less than that of a general, so he can burst out of martial arts power?"
Tu Qin was whispering in disbelief, "In the middle, there are three great realms between Wu Shuai and King Wu, how can this be possible!"
And when Tu Qinzheng was shocked, Ji Ruxue suddenly appeared astonished!
"Brother Su Lang!"
Ji Ruxue's little face was full of surprise, "Brother Su Lang, I feel that there is a aura that is very similar to mine in those whirlwinds just now!"
"what?"
"Blood breath?"
Su Lang's expression was startled, but he kept walking, "Could it be that you have half the blood of the Wind Spirit clan?"
"This... seems to be more than that!"
"It seems to be a closer relationship!"
Ji Ruxue raised her head to look up at Tu Qinzheng who was above her, her pair of beauty stared wide.
"Huh? A closer relationship?"
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "Could it be your father?"
At this time, in the sky, Tu Qin's eyes narrowed, "Such a weird young human race, it is better to beheaded!
Thinking of this, Tu Qin showed a cold face on the front, and exclaimed: "Qing Hui-Potian Sword!"
A super big sword with a length of over a hundred meters appeared in the sky, and its tip firmly locked Su Lang!
"Fucked!"
"I am now at a multi-wuzun level, and I cannot resist the Valkyrie at all!"
In an instant, Su Lang felt like falling into an ice cave, his whole head cold from head to toe!
At this time, he had already swallowed eight clones, and even if he was devouring the last one to escape, it was completely useless!
At this time, the hundred-meter sword in the sky, carrying the power of Mount Tai, stabbed down fiercely!
Su Lang's eyes shrank suddenly, and he tried all his strength to escape, but he was still watched closely by the sword.
It only takes 3 seconds!
He, Ji Ruxue and others will be cut to pieces by this Valkyrie-level sword!
"Could it be..."
Su Lang showed grief, "Am I going to give up the guardian again?"
At this time!
"stop!!"
"I don't know who you are, but you must have a very close relationship with me!"
Ji Ruxue suddenly shouted desperately, "Brother Su Lang is my savior, I forbid you to kill him!"
Her voice was so heartbreaking, and blood came roaring from her pink mouth!

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Ji Ruxue's father!
paragraphs: Seeing Ji Ruxue whose mouth was red, Su Lang felt a tingling pain in his heart.
And just now!
The sword in the sky suddenly stopped in the air!
This sudden scene caused Su Lang and the others to be shocked.
"Lying down!"
Su Lang opened his mouth wide in shock, "Is Tu Qinzheng really Ji Ruxue's father?"
Murong Xianxian and Granny Ke were also so shocked that they were stunned, their faces dull.
At this time.
"Humph!"
"Since my daughter is pleading for you."
Tu Qin was humming softly, "Then I will spare you once."
As soon as he finished speaking, Tu Qinzheng stretched out his hand and flicked it lightly, and immediately isolated Su Lang and Cong Ji Ruxue.
Immediately afterwards, he flicked a single finger, and an invisible force fell on Su Lang.
"I fork!"
Su Lang's expression changed, and his whole person turned into a streamer, disappearing to the horizon in an instant!
"Brother Su Lang!!"
Ji Ruxue looked at the direction in which Su Lang disappeared, and her pair of Qiushui cut pupils immediately burst into tears.
"Oh? My daughter has such a deep affection for this human race?
Tu Qin raised his brows, and immediately showed contempt, "Unfortunately, no matter how weird it is, it is only a human race, and I am not qualified to be my daughter's Taoist companion!"
Thinking of this, Tu Qinzheng's gaze fell on Ji Ruxue, and there was a trace of uncontrollable excitement on his face.
Immediately afterwards, he stretched out his hand and grabbed it, and a soft force fell on Ji Ruxue to take it away.

The abrupt space-time crack was suddenly shaken and twisted, and it was a little unstable!

chapters.title: Chapter 226: The death of Cao Zuo Jiyuan!
paragraphs: "what happened!?"
The three Cao Zuo looked at them in shock.
Soon after, they saw a frightening scene!

Although this streamer is small, it contains extremely terrifying energy.
Although this energy is far from reaching the Martial God level, it is also a Wuzun level, which is not something that the three of Cao Zuo can resist.

"Heaven! The Wind Spirit Race Warrior still didn't let us go!"
"Why... why is this?"

"Do not!!"

Immediately afterwards, Cao Zuo's body was shrouded in streamer, and instantly disappeared.
A generation of Wu Huang and Dongfang Town Shou was killed like an ant.
Ji Yuan was even more unbearable than Cao Zuo. He was silently annihilated as soon as he was hit by the streamer, and he did not even send out the last scream and roar.
Among the three, only Ren Tianfeng survived.
He is not only an Intermediate Martial Emperor, but also a tutor from the Xuanyuan Academy from the main city of Blue Star. He has a lot more methods than Cao Zuo Jiyuan!
With a powerful defensive treasure, plus various other defenses, he finally saved his life under the stream of light that was divided into three.
However, that was a powerful attack beyond the Wuhuang level after all.
Although Ren Tianfeng saved his life, he was also seriously injured and dying, dying on the roof of a building.
The three martial emperors were almost wiped out in an instant!
Seeing this scene, everyone in Dongfang City opened their mouths in disbelief!
"Master Cao Zuo, Master Ji Yuan is dead!"
"Master Ren Tianfeng doesn't know whether he lives or die, this..."
"Why is it like this? The Wind Spirit Race Martial God has already left!"
The warriors who recovered from the shock immediately fell into a panic.
"This matter... should end here... Hurry up and organize staff to appease the residents of the city!"
"If you come, go to the Oriental City Building immediately to get the spare letter jade medallion, and contact the Blue Star main city!"
One of the most powerful King Wu took a deep breath and issued two orders in a row.
"Yes!"
The rest of the Wu Kings who had lingering fears nodded their heads.
The death of Emperor Cao Zuo and other Emperor Wu is indeed terrifying, but at least, Dongfang City is still there!
But at this moment!
A more shocking and desperate scene happened!
I saw a burst of light burst out of the constantly distorted and extremely unstable space-time crack.
"Roar--!"
"Wow!"
When the time-space channel collapsed, with countless beast roars, densely packed fierce beasts flew out of the cracks in time and space!
These fierce beasts are really all flying!
Because they are all A-level and S-level beasts, that is to say, these beasts are all Wuwang Wuhuang level!
Each of these huge beasts is like a thousand-meter mountain.
And their number has reached a terrifying 66, of which 48 are A-level and 18 are S-level!
They flew in the sky, and the falling shadows enveloped the entire Eastern City!
At the same time, that terrifying aura also permeated the entire Eastern City, and the joy of every human warrior instantly solidified, and then quickly turned into panic and despair!
The appearance of so many A-level and S-level beasts at the same time surpassed everyone's expectations and imagination!
at the same time!
Scarlet light beams of warning light rose up outside the city!
In a short period of time, hundreds of red light beams rose into the sky, and the entire Eastern City was almost plunged into a hell.
Just the A-level and S-level beasts in the sky can no longer resist.
Now, there is a wave of fierce beasts on the ground, which undoubtedly cut off the retreat of everyone in Dongfang City!

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Poor ants
paragraphs: "It's over--!!!"
"That Martial God-level Wind Spirit Race actually left so many powerful beasts!"
The King Wu who issued the order contracted his pupils abruptly, "Just those A-level fierce beasts are not something I can resist. To survive, I have to escape!"
"Damn the Wind Spirit Race!"
Another King Wu's eyes were splitting, "Our Eastern City has resisted how many fierce beasts, but it is still going to be turned into ruins!"
"There is hope in life."
Another King Wu took a hard breath, "Run away!"
"There are too many fierce beasts, don't be scattered."
"Let's go together, the chances of survival are greater!"
The leader Wu Wang shouted loudly, and then immediately fled to the horizon, and the other Wu Wang immediately followed after seeing this.
Seeing that all the martial kings were running away, the warriors of Dongfang City on the ground suddenly lost all hope!
But at this moment.
A figure exuding a frightening atmosphere, dragging a long sonic burst cloud trail, descended on the East City!
"what!?"
Those Martial Kings were fleeing, feeling this powerful aura, they were suddenly more shocked and desperate.
"Wu Zun level!"
The headed King Wu looked desperate, "Can we still escape?"
At this time, a King Wu swallowed hard.
Then he turned his head tremblingly and looked, suddenly his face was ecstatic: "It's a human figure!!"
"What! Human figure?
"Didn't the time-space cracks collapsed? It is impossible for the Wind Spirit Clan to come!"
"Could it be...is it our human power?"
The other King Wu looked at each other, and immediately showed ecstasy.
If a Wuzun-level powerhouse comes to the rescue, then Dongfang City will definitely be spared this time!
At this time, the sonic boom like a dragon spread to the center of Dongfang City and stopped.
As the sonic boom cloud dissipated, everyone stared at it.
However, when they saw the person's face clearly, they suddenly exclaimed as if they had seen a ghost.
"Su——Su Lang!!"
"How could it be him? How could his breath be so strong?"
"The aura on his body is one level stronger than that of Emperor Wu. Has he jumped from the rank of Emperor Wu to Emperor Wu!?"
"My eyes must have been changed by someone else, or I'm in a illusion, this is not true, it is definitely not true!"
"But everyone has seen it, he is Su Lang!"
"Damn, he is the remnant of the Wind Spirit Clan, he must have been with those fierce beasts, he is going to slaughter us!"
The entire Eastern City, from the body-shaders at the bottom to the high-ranking King Wu, all talked in horror.
"Poor ants.
Su Lang shook his head helplessly, "Until now, he has been blinded by lies."
Originally, after being bombarded by Tu Qin for thousands of miles, Su Lang didn't plan to return.
However, for one thing, the big feud has not yet been reported, and secondly, he cannot watch the Dongfang City ruined.
At this time, Tu Qinzheng had already left. Although those fierce beasts were powerful, they were only at the pinnacle Martial Emperor level, and they were not yet Su Lang's opponent.
Therefore, he used the last clone to dispatch and replace the clone back to Eastern City.
"Forget it, I don't bother to care about you ignorant ants."
Su Lang indifferently looked down at the black crowd on the ground, and immediately curled his lips, casting his gaze into the dense crowd of fierce beasts in the sky.
These fierce beasts are terrifying death to others.
But in Su Lang's eyes, these A-level and S-level beasts are all treasures!
As long as you kill these beasts, you will surely be able to sell them for a good price!
"Tsk tusk, Ji Ruxue's father is still good!"
There was a hint of excitement on Su Lang's face, "He gave me such a generous gift before I left, hehe, darlings, I'm here!"
Immediately afterwards, he took out the Beidou Feihong Sword and stepped on it into the sky.
Those A-level and S-level fierce beasts are not ordinary goods, and their IQs are not low.
So they all planned to start massacring the city, but after feeling the strong breath of Su Lang, they immediately stopped their actions and became vigilant.
Seeing Su Lang rushing up at this time, they felt a strong danger coming, and they suddenly felt panic and began to flee.
At the same time, the A-level and S-level fierce beasts who commanded the tide of fierce beasts outside the city all fled with their tails between them.
The low-level fierce beasts that make up the wave of fierce beasts also fled frantically.

"Oh my God, it's saved!"
"Su Lang is going to kill those fierce beasts, Master Su Lang belongs to us!"
This guy roared wildly, and suddenly more and more people woke up.
"Master Su Lang is really killing those fierce beasts!"
"So powerful, so strong, he killed an S-rank fierce beast!"
"Master Su Lang is not the remnant of the Wind Spirit Clan, he is our human hero!"
"Master Su Lang! I was wrong, I really know I was wrong, I shouldn't slander you, I'll kneel down for you!"
"Master Su Lang is the savior of our Eastern City! Kneel and thank Master Su Lang, and thank Master Su!"
"Master Su Lang is a hero and our savior. Ji Yuan and Cao Zuo slander Master Su Lang and deceive us. It's hard to die!"

Countless people exclaimed, and then knelt on the ground one by one, and even more so, they kept kowtow and burst into tears!

Immediately afterwards, he gritted his teeth fiercely and hurriedly fled away.
But at this moment, several Wu Wang exchanged glances and immediately intercepted!
"What are you doing!?"
Ji Ge looked at the King Wu who intercepted them with his eyes split, his whole person began to tremble uncontrollably.
"Humph!"
"Because your Ji family deceived us, we will be enemies of Su Da!
A King Wu said with a sneer, "Do you want to leave now?
It's just a delusion!"
Ji Ge said in horror, "You... don't forget that behind my Ji family is the ancient Jin family of the hidden world!"
"What about the Jin family?"
The strongest Martial King shouted sharply, "Your Ji family brutalizes human geniuses, refines human pill to satisfy selfish desires, and everyone gets it and punishes them.
How dare the Jin family protect your Ji family?"
"Yes, Ji Ge, you don't want to run away again!"
Another Wu Wang said, "Wash your neck and wait for Master Su Lang to clean up you!"
Ji Ge was desperate, trembling all over, unable to speak.
Seeing Ji Ge confessed his fate, the headed King Wu ordered again to arrest many of the Ji family.
The other side.
"Seven Stars Hidden Kill!"
"Blowing the snow without a trace!"
"Black Flame of Falling Sun!"
"I will kill, kill, kill, kill!"
Su Lang resorted to full-body methods to frantically massacre the fleeing beasts.
"Ding!
You get Tianxiang Bird and Beast King Pill*1, Tianxiang Bird and Beast King Soul*1, Tianxiang Bird Feather*998..."
"Ding!
You get the Heavenly Shaking Deer Beast Pill*1, the Heavenly Shaking Deer Beast Soul*1, the Heavenly Deer Antlers*2, and the Heavenly Deer Skin*1..."
"Ding!
You get...
All the fierce beasts killed by Su Lang had no waste at all, and they were all perfectly divided and stored by the system.
Moreover, these king-level and imperial-level fierce beasts actually have beast pills and beast souls, which sounds like a good thing!
"Hahahaha, refreshing!"
Su Lang gets better and better as he kills.
A total of 66 powerful beasts were killed by him in a moment!
However, Su Lang did not stop there, because there were also eight A-level fierce beasts and two S-level fierce beasts in the beast tide outside the city.
At this time they are running away.
"Huh!
Can you escape?"
Su Lang twitched the corner of his mouth and rushed up with the sword in his hand.
In a short while-
"The last one!"
Su Lang kicked on the corpse of an S-class fierce beast, holding up his long sword, turning into a streamer to kill the last fierce beast.
"Roar!!"
After a desperate cry, the last S-class fierce beast died under Su Lang's sword!
So far.
The terrible catastrophe, which was enough to destroy Dongfang City dozens of times, was so easily resolved by Su Lang.
"A total of 56 A-level fierce beasts and 20 S-level fierce beasts, this time I made a profit!"
Su Lang showed excitement, and hurried towards the eastern city.
The tide of fierce beasts has been resolved, and his grudges have not yet been reported.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Pay the price one by one
paragraphs: Overcome the barriers turned into ruins.
Su Lang returned to Dongfang City again.
However, just as he was going to pursue those Martial Kings who had fled, he saw a group of people flying towards him.
"Oh? It's automatically delivered to the door? Very familiar!"
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth, and stood there waiting leisurely.
Not long.
The Yiwu King came to Su Lang.
"Meet Master Su Lang!"
All King Wu knelt down in front of Su Lang.
Na Ji Ge was pressed firmly by the four Martial Kings, and his face on the ground was deformed.
"It seems that you are very smart!"
"Unfortunately, you still have to pay for what you have done."
Su Lang looked down at the people condescendingly, a sneer appeared on his face.
"Master Su Lang!"
The headed King Wu slammed his head to the ground, "I am willing to pay for my fault, and I beg Master Su Lang to punish!"
"Well, I just admitted my mistake without finding a reason, that's good."
Su Lang clicked the corner of his mouth and said, "I remember you, you only participated in the hunt for me, right."
"Yes, Lord Su Lang!"
The headed King Wu dared not look up, and replied hurriedly.
"If this is the case, then you have to pay all your net worth, including the exercises.
Su Lang smiled faintly, and immediately stretched out his hand to point out one by one, "You, you...you people, you can leave after you hand over your wealth and exercises."
"Thank you Lord Su Lang!"
"Thank you Lord Su Lang for your mercy!"
"I will not hide a copper coin privately!"
The martial kings who were spotted were grateful, then handed over all their wealth, and took out jade slips.
These jade slips are about the same length and size as the barrel of a brush, and the texture is a special jade.
At the Wuwang level, the exercises practiced by the warriors are basically not recorded in books, but recorded in this jade slip.
This kind of jade slips can be read directly with mental power, which is very convenient and easier for the students to understand the contents.
Moreover, the jade slip can be ‘locked’ in various ways. If you don’t know how to ‘unlock’ and read the content rashly, the jade slip will destroy itself.
With this method of preventing the leakage of the exercises, almost none of the warriors above the Wuwang will destroy the original exercises.
At this time, these martial kings unlocked the jade slips so that Su Lang could study them.
Soon, the martial kings who were spotted by Su Lang took out all their wealth and exercises.
Some people also asked if they wanted to send the family home too, but Su Lang refused.
If the hatred is not great, just copy the home.
"Well, you guys step aside."
Su Lang waved his hand faintly, and then put all his wealth and exercises into the storage space.
"Yes! Lord Su Lang!
All the martial kings got up from the ground and stepped aside respectfully.
"Next, it's your turn."
Su Lang's gaze fell on Ji Ge and the other King Wu.
Except for Ji Ge and several Ji Family Wu Kings, the other Wu King's families and Ji family were in the same foul, and they did a lot of bad things, so they were left by Su Lang.
At this time, being stared at by Su Lang, they suddenly felt a chill on their backs and sweating all over!
"As for you, in the big environment of Dongfang City, you have to go with the Ji family.
However, doing bad things is doing bad things, and you still have to pay the price! "
Su Lang's voice was very indifferent, "Now that you three Wuwang families have been ransacked by me, I don't want to kill you.
Now, you take out all your belongings, and then go back and clean up the most wicked people in your family, and you will be fine.
Remember, especially for those who take human pills, whether it is you, your son or grandson, I have to die! "
Having said this, Su Lang's gaze fell on the Wu Kings who had retreated to the side: "You come to supervise this matter, but there is a difference, kill you!"
"Yes!"
All the martial kings immediately knelt to take orders.
"Thank you, Master Su Lang, for your kindness!"
The three members of the Wuwang clan who were in the same affair with the Ji family kowtow to thank you.
Immediately after they took out all their wealth and exercises, they were driven to the side by Su Lang.
"Now, you are left, Ji Ge!"
Su Lang looked down at Ji Ge and the other five Ji Jiawu Kings, and the sneer at the corner of his mouth became stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: You still have last words
paragraphs: Su Lang stared at him with cold eyes.
Ji Ge and the other five family elders are all creepy, like falling into an ice cave!
At this moment, they knew that their destiny had reached a threshold, whether death or life was between Su Lang's thoughts.
However, no one wanted to die!
"Master Su Lang!"
A Jijiawu king said with a trembling, "I am the fourth elder of the Ji family. Ji Ge and I have never dealt with each other. He persecuted me for everything!
When I arrested Ji Ge before, I was the first to do it. I have never had the intention of being an enemy of Master Su Lang! "
"Yes, Master Su Lang!"
"Ji Ge has done anything wrong and led the Ji family astray. I am already dissatisfied."
Another Jijiawu King pleaded, "Why...however, Ji Ge controls the family to death, and the paternal master is too supportive. We can only be forced to join in the same trouble!"
"Master Su Lang, it really wasn't my intention to be an enemy of you."
The third King Ji Jiawu said, "Please be kind and forgive me!"
"You...you white-eyed wolves who eat inside and out!"
Ji Ge looked at his three Martial Kings very sadly, "It's in vain that I'm so good to you!"
Regarding Ji Ge's abuse, the three Martial Kings who were begging for mercy turned a deaf ear to them, all knelt in front of Su Lang, and continued to kowtow to beg for mercy.
"Hehe, everyone can't help it?"
Su Lang sneered, "If you want to resist Ji Ge, is there really no way?
If you work together, even if you can't fight Ji Ge, at least you can go to the Blue Star main city to sue.
Just the matter of Jing Qianyi's refining the human pill, can make the Ji family unable to eat.
Why don't you go? It's not because you are so dirty!
Even if you really don't deal with Ji Ge, the bad things you have done are not much less than Ji Ge!
Just talk about Ji Ruxue. If you can stand up against it, will her mother and sister and those relatives and friends die? Will she be driven to death?
You from top to toe, I will let you go when I am blind! "
Speaking of this, Su Lang's murderous aura overflowed, and he immediately cut it down with a sword.
"Huh!!"
A cold sword light flashed away, and the three Wu Wangs were in different places immediately!
Three magnificent blood springs sprayed out from the neck fracture, and the smell of blood immediately permeated a radius of tens of meters.
Seeing the three beheaded kings of the Ji family, the martial kings standing next to them all showed horror and fear.
Ji Ge and the other two Ji elders who were kneeling on the ground were even more frightened, shaking all over.
"Ji Ge, do you have any last words?"
Su Lang raised his hand and handed it, Sen Han's sword reached the center of Ji Ge's forehead.
"Su Lang... I... Behind my Ji family is the Jin family of the ancient family of hermits!"
Ji Ge said tremblingly, "If you kill me, the Jin family will definitely not let you go!"
"Ha ha!"
"Dare to threaten me when I die?"
Su Lang looked down at Ji Ge, with a touch of coldness at the corner of his mouth, "It seems that you don't want to die happily. If so, then I will fulfill you!"
As soon as the voice fell, Su Lang moved his wrist and the sharp sword instantly peeled off Ji Ge's face!
"what--!!"
Although Ji Ge is the King of Martial Arts, he has been pampering him for so many years. At this time, his face was stripped and he immediately howled in pain!
"Can't bear this pain?"
Su Lang sneered coldly, his wrist turned again, and Ji Ge was enveloped by a chill of sword light.
In the next moment, Ji Ge separated his limbs and became a stick!
A lot of blood flowed from his wound, forming a dazzling pool of blood on the ground.
"Ah! It hurts!"
Ji Ge opened his mouth wide and screamed like a pig.
The bitter cry penetrated more than a dozen buildings, and even the warriors on the Oriental City Square heard it.
"It hurts, right?"
Su Lang's voice seemed to come from the abyss, "But it still can't match the pain Ji Ruxue endured.
It can't compare to the pain of those talented warriors who have been refined with human pill! "
While talking, Su Lang danced his long sword, sword after sword Ling Chi, Ji Ge.
"Ho ho..."
Ji Ge's eyes burst in pain, and his whole body twitched, and he couldn't even speak.
After a long time, Su Lang stopped the sword, and Ji Ge was bloody, like a meatball, it was terrible to watch.
However, the powerful vitality of King Wu level made him still not dead!
And Su Lang didn't intend to let him be relieved so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: Let him live better than death
paragraphs: "Life is better than death for the rest of your life. Repent!"
Su Lang stabbed out with a sword, and abolished Ji Ge's dantian and spiritual core.
In an instant, a huge aura leaked from Ji Ge and gradually returned to the world.
Ji Ge's dantian was destroyed, the spiritual core was annihilated, and the vitality in his body was quickly lost.
Su Lang sneered, grabbed a handful of healing pills and stuffed it into Ji Ge's mouth.
"Woohoo!!"
Ji Ge made a painful sound, his face dripping down, disgusting.
"It's disgusting."
Su Lang curled his lips and looked at the two remaining Ji Jiawu Kings.
At this moment, the two Wu Wangs lost their eyes, motionless, and gave up all resistance.
Su Lang didn't intend to torture these two people, so he killed them with a single sword!
With the heads of the two Jijiawu Kings falling to the ground, two more blood bursts into the sky.
"You people."
"Be sure to let Ji Ge live rather than die."
Su Lang's icy gaze fell on the trembling Wu Kings beside him, "Until he is over!"
"Yes!!"
More than a dozen King Wu said in unison, knelt down and bowed in unison.
"Okay, Dongfang City is a waste of time, go ahead."
Su Lang received Ji Ge's space ring, and a bit of his feet immediately disappeared.
Seeing the afterimage of Su Lang's gradual annihilation, all the martial kings let out a sigh of relief, and then looked at Ji Ge with lingering fears.
The other side.
After Su Lang left, he went directly to the roof of a building.
There was a huge cobweb-like crack in the middle of the roof, and the whole roof almost collapsed.
And in the center of the spiderweb crack lies Ren Tianfeng, whose life is unknown.
Cao Zuo, Ji Yuan, and Ren Tianfeng were hit by the streamer.
The former two died and annihilated directly, while the latter fell to the ground unclearly. This scene was witnessed by Su Lang through his clone.
Therefore, he is very clear about Ren Tianfeng's position.
Come and take a look at this time, just to see if there is any cheaper.
After all, Ren Tianfeng is an intermediate martial emperor from Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, the main city of Blue Star, and his wealth is absolutely rich!
Taking a step forward, Su Lang came to Ren Tianfeng's side, and his expression immediately moved.
"You haven't died yet?"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, and he clearly felt that there was still a trace of life in Ren Tian Feng's body.
However, this vitality is very weak, if Ren Tianfeng is left alone, he will die in less than an hour.
"Sooner or later I will die, I will help you."
With a tick at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, he was about to choke Ren Tianfeng.
But at this moment, a thought suddenly emerged, causing Su Lang to stop.
"It is said that Xuanyuan Wudao Academy is the best institution on Blue Star."
"It contains the most precious resources in the world."
"There are all kinds of treasures, exercises and classics, and they are all the best in the world!"
"As long as you become a student of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, you can get it!
"Originally, I had no idea about Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy. Only the highest grade qualification can enter this ghost place, but now..."
Thinking of this, Su Lang showed a smile on his face.
Immediately, he took out a king-level healing medicine and stuffed it into Ren Tianfeng's mouth.
Yes, Su Lang wants to treat Ren Tianfeng.
Speaking of it, Ren Tianfeng is different from Ji Yuan, Ji Ge, and Cao Zuo.
This guy is not a villain in nature.
Although he teamed up with Cao Zuo Jiyuan to hunt down Su Lang, if he could let Su Lang enter the Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, the previous hatred would not be inevitable.
Of course, if Ren Tianfeng couldn't let Su Lang enter the Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
Su Lang doesn't mind cutting off his head!
"Huh...cough cough!!"
Not long after taking the pill, Ren Tianfeng got better and slowly opened his eyes.
Immediately, he saw a young face that was not smiling.
"Su Lang!!!"
Ren Tianfeng was full of spirits, his pupils shrunk like soybeans.
Immediately afterwards, he instinctively wanted to do it!
"Humph!"
Su Lang snorted coldly, and the terrifying aura of Wu Zun-class suppressed severely.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Shocked Ren Tianfeng
paragraphs: "Wu Zun!?"
In an instant, Ren Tianfeng's eyes suddenly burst, and the whole person seemed to have seen a ghost.
He couldn't figure out how long he grew a hundred heads. Su Lang was obviously just a relatively strong Martial King, how could he suddenly become Martial Lord! ?
"Yes, do you still dare to do it?"
"What's more, I am your savior!"
Su Lang withdrew his Wuzun-level aura, and said lightly, "If you don't have me, you can't wake up."
"You...you saved me!?"
Ren Tianfeng opened his mouth wide in shock, with an incredible expression on his face.
"Could anyone else save you?"
Su Lang glanced at Ren Tianfeng faintly, "I won't sell you anymore. The reason I saved you is because I want to enter Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
As the admissions tutor of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, can you do it?
It doesn't matter if you can't, I will kill you. "
"Goooo!"
Ren Tianfeng swallowed hard.
He didn't care about all the doubts in his heart, and said quickly, "I...I still have some privileges, but..."
"but what?"
Su Lang frowned and asked.
"But... it must be at least the best qualification."

paragraphs: "Gosh."
Ren Tianfeng stared at Su Lang, "I'm not dreaming, am I?"
Seeing this scene, Su Lang's mouth twitched and his face was speechless.
Then, he took a deep breath and slapped Ren Tianfeng's face with a slap in the face!
"Snapped--!"
In the loud slap in the face, Ren Tianfeng rotated ten times in place before stopping.
"Uh...it hurts!!"
Ren Tianfeng was stunned, and immediately covered his swollen face.
By this time, although he still couldn't accept what he saw and heard just now, at least he was fully awake.
"Dignified Martial Emperor, can you be a little bit knowledgeable?"
Su Lang patted Ren Tianfeng on the shoulder, "It's really useless to make you like this with a little pill."

Ren Tian showed a wry smile on the cover, "It's horrible to come up with so many cherished perfect quality pills in one breath!"

Su Lang curled his lips, "I want to enter Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy. Age is not a problem, but there is something wrong with my qualifications. I am a muddy body."

"My situation is special.
Su Lang smiled faintly, "Let's talk, can this problem of cultivation qualification be solved?

"I also hate the matter of refining pills."

However, as long as I write a letter and trust favors, I can avoid this review. "
"In that case, you can write it."
Su Lang nodded, and then his voice fell cold, "You can't say what you have seen and heard today, otherwise you will bear the consequences."
"Don't worry, I won't leak a word of today's matter!"
"You save my life regardless of the predecessors, I can't do it yet!"
Ren Tianfeng solemnly said, "What's more, you are the genius among the geniuses, the evildoer among the evildoers!
Terran is really lucky to have a super genius like you.
In time, you will be able to become a Valkyrie, even beyond the existence of Valkyrie!

"Okay, when shall I go?"
Su Lang nodded and asked, "When you finish enrolling students, go with the new students?"
"No, nearly 30 days are the enrollment period."
Ren Tianfeng said, "You Lu has always been at the enrollment point of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, so you can just find him directly."
"If this is the case, then I will set off immediately."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I'll leave the mess of Dongfang City to you."
After speaking, without waiting for Ren Tianfeng to answer, Su Lang moved and disappeared into the distance.
Soon, Su Lang arrived at the airport.
At this time, the airport has not yet resumed operations, but this is not difficult for Su Lang.
He sent a clone to find a King Wu and asked him to arrange an aura airship.
Not long after, the aura airship with only the airship pilot and Su Lang rose slowly and flew towards the main city of Blue Star.

Ordinary high-level exercises do not have such high-end treatment.

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Good things come in pairs, wonderful!
paragraphs: Immediately afterwards, he will begin to practice exercises.
But Su Lang suddenly remembered that his own pictures of Blowing Snow Without Marks, Black Flame Records of Falling Sun, and Fengwu Taixu Art were still being practiced.
"Calculated based on the time of breakthrough."
"These three advanced exercises should take another 4 hours to reach the Consummation level. You might as well wait to practice other exercises."
Thinking of this, Su Lang gave up his plan to practice the new exercise immediately.
Time passed, and 4 hours passed in a blink of an eye.
"Ding! Fuxue Wuhentu has reached the perfect level!"
"Ding! The Black Flame Record of Falling Sun has reached the level of Consummation!"
"Ding! Fengwu Taixu Jue has reached the perfect level!"
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, will you break through immediately?"
After four consecutive system prompts came, Su Lang suddenly felt excited and bounced off the bed.
"Good things come in pairs, wonderful, wonderful!"
Su Lang's eyes were excited for a while, and then he ordered, "System, break through immediately!"
Follow the instructions.
A torrent of aura suddenly appeared in Su Lang's body.
Within the union, the aura in the surrounding air was also torn away, and was swallowed by Su Lang as if it had encountered a black hole.
For a time.
Su Lang unexpectedly appeared an aura vacuum area!
A large amount of spiritual energy rushed into Su Lang's body, and then all entered the dantian, and merged with the spiritual energy cyclone.
Immediately afterwards, the aura cyclone that occupied the entire Dantian began to condense and become smaller.
In a short while, the aura cyclone shrank to one-tenth of its original size, and the whole body became a radiant liquid!
At this moment, the Aura Cyclone is no longer a Aura Cyclone, but an Aura Vortex!
After the spiritual fluid vortex condenses, a large amount of liquid spiritual energy is released.
These auras replaced the original gaseous auras in Su Lang's body, occupying all of Su Lang's meridians.
At the same time, under the nourishment of these spiritual energy, Su Lang's body was rapidly strengthening.
Skeletal muscles, meridians, blood, skin...Even every hair has been strengthened!
This strengthening lasted an entire hour before it gradually disappeared.
At this time, Su Lang also officially broke through to the junior general level!
"The power brought by the cultivation realm is steadfast!"
Feeling the thick liquid spirit like lead and mercury, and feeling the body strengthened and strengthened from the inside to the outside, Su Lang was refreshed.
Although he has piled up his true combat power to the level of King Wu through one-click martial arts training, his own cultivation level is the greatest source of confidence.
Moreover, the realm of cultivation represents the improvement and evolution of the life level, which is more essential and powerful than real combat power!
It is precisely because of this that Su Lang regards the one-key practice function as the most important function.
With an extremely refreshing mood, Su Lang placed three new exercises.
This time I chose the top-level exercises, namely Ruyang Ling Juelu, Tiankui Liucai Axis, and Tianwang Body Refining Classic.
The reason for choosing the top-level exercises was the decision made by Su Lang after asking the system.
At present, it only takes 12 hours to complete the advanced exercises.
It takes 60 hours to practice the top level exercises to complete, while the king level exercises takes 300 hours!
High-level exercises require a short time, but as Su Lang's strength increases, this level of exercises will soon lose its effect.
The king-level exercises took too long, more than ten days.
The top-level exercises consume less than three days, the benefits are also very good, and the cost performance is the highest.
After placing the exercises, Su Lang took another handful of pills, and then lay on the bed and fell asleep happily.
In the process of Su Lang's constantly changing sleeping positions, the aura airship gradually reached the main city of Blue Star.
The main city of Blue Star is the largest city on this planet.
Its area is not known how many times wider than Eastern City.
Even with Su Lang's eyesight, he couldn't see the edge of the main city of Blue Star!
And here, it is more like a future city in a peaceful age, and it is still the kind of super city that integrates the civilization of the entire planet.
The city is full of strange and grand buildings.
The dense clusters of small aura vehicles travel in an orderly manner among the tall buildings, just like the cars of Su Lang's previous life.
This scene made Su Lang's eyes intently and praised.

At this time, Su Lang also officially broke through to the junior general level!
"The power brought by the cultivation realm is steadfast!"
Feeling the thick liquid spirit like lead and mercury, and feeling the body strengthened and strengthened from the inside to the outside, Su Lang was refreshed.
Although he has piled up his true combat power to the level of King Wu through one-click martial arts training, his own cultivation level is the greatest source of confidence.
Moreover, the realm of cultivation represents the improvement and evolution of the life level, which is more essential and powerful than real combat power!
It is precisely because of this that Su Lang regards the one-key practice function as the most important function.
With an extremely refreshing mood, Su Lang placed three new exercises.
This time I chose the top-level exercises, namely Ruyang Ling Juelu, Tiankui Liucai Axis, and Tianwang Body Refining Classic.
The reason for choosing the top-level exercises was the decision made by Su Lang after asking the system.
At present, it only takes 12 hours to complete the advanced exercises.
It takes 60 hours to practice the top level exercises to complete, while the king level exercises takes 300 hours!
High-level exercises require a short time, but as Su Lang's strength increases, this level of exercises will soon lose its effect.
The king-level exercises took too long, more than ten days.
The top-level exercises consume less than three days, the benefits are also very good, and the cost performance is the highest.
After placing the exercises, Su Lang took another handful of pills, and then lay on the bed and fell asleep happily.
In the process of Su Lang's constantly changing sleeping positions, the aura airship gradually reached the main city of Blue Star.
The main city of Blue Star is the largest city on this planet.
Its area is not known how many times wider than Eastern City.
Even with Su Lang's eyesight, he couldn't see the edge of the main city of Blue Star!
And here, it is more like a future city in a peaceful age, and it is still the kind of super city that integrates the civilization of the entire planet.
The city is full of strange and grand buildings.
The dense clusters of small aura vehicles travel in an orderly manner among the tall buildings, just like the cars of Su Lang's previous life.
This scene made Su Lang's eyes intently and praised.

chapters.title: Chapter 236: I'm used to it
paragraphs: "My lord, we are about to land!"
The respectful voice of the pilot of the aura airship came.
Immediately, Su Lang felt a sense of weightlessness, and it was obvious that the aura airship had begun to descend.
Not long after, under the command of the main airport of Blue Star, the Aura airship landed on the apron.
"I'm leaving, do it yourself."
Su Lang waved his hand at the pilot of the airship and got off the airship.
As the largest city for mankind, the airport here is extremely busy, and there are many warriors boarding and disembarking.
Following the warriors of another aura airship, Su Lang came to a hall.
"Welcome to the main city of Bluestar, please pay the entrance fee of 10,000 high-grade spirit stones."
"Passengers who come to the main city of Bluestar for the first time are requested to apply for an ID card. Those without an ID card will not be able to enter the city.
"Passengers with ID cards can leave the airport after passing the check."
Su Lang was stunned by a series of broadcast sounds.
"You have to pay 10,000 high-grade spirit stones to enter the city? It's really black! This is equivalent to 10 billion gold coins!"
Su Lang curled his mouth and uttered, "It's really strong to have to apply for an ID card."
However, complaints return to complaints, and Su Lang still understands the truth.
After all, the main city of Bluestar is the largest city for human beings, which represents the strongest, safest and most abundant resources here.
However, no matter how big the main city of Bluestar is, no matter how many resources it is, it is limited.
If a high threshold is not set, then all the people in the world will not be able to come over...
Under the guidance of the broadcast, Su Lang paid the entrance fee, applied for an identity card, and then received a map and a booklet.
The map is the map of the main city of Bluestar, and the booklet contains some matters needing attention.
Looking through the brochure, Su Lang passed the inspection smoothly and came outside the airport.
Compared to the airport, the outside is more prosperous and people are everywhere on the road.
With their relaxed expressions and smiling faces, Su Lang couldn't help but feel like a dream.
"There is no depression and haze brought by the beasts here."
"The human beings who can live here are more than 10,000 times happier than human beings elsewhere."
Su Lang sighed, and then took out the map he received when he paid the entrance fee.
"It's time to go to Xuanyuan Wudao Academy"
Looking at the map, Su Lang quickly found the location of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy-Xuanyuan Mountain!
"Little brother, where are you going?"
A small aura aircraft stopped in front of Su Lang, and a bald uncle stretched his neck and asked.
"Go to Xuanyuan Wudao Academy."
Su Lang's mouth twitched and smiled.
"Xuanyuan Wudao Academy!?"
Uncle Bald opened his mouth in shock, "God, are you a new student in this class?"
Originally, he still wanted to kill Su Lang a piece of spiritual stone, but after knowing that Su Lang was going to Xuanyuan Wudao Academy, he immediately put out his bad thoughts.
"Yes, I am a new student."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "How many spirit stones were needed in the past?"
"Don't need Lingshi, get in the car, I'll take you there for free!"
Uncle bald smiled and opened the back door of the aircraft.
"It's not necessary for free."
Su Lang smiled, and he wanted to get on the aura aircraft.
At this time, a system prompt caused Su Lang's movements to pause slightly.
"Ding! The sea of repair is full, do you break through?"
"I slept for so long before, and it's time for a breakthrough again!"
Su Lang was delighted, and while sitting on the Aura Aircraft, he chose to break through.
In an instant, a flood of spiritual energy rushed into the dantian and merged into the spiritual fluid vortex.
And the surrounding spirits also poured into Su Lang's body like a tide.
After a few breaths, Su Lang sent a very obvious breakthrough wave!
"My God, brother, did you break through?"
Uncle bald turned around in disbelief, "I made a breakthrough while walking!?"
"Well, I'm used to it."
Su Lang nodded, showing a faint smile.
"Uh...get used to it!?"
"It's worthy of being a new student of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy!"
Uncle Bald was amazed, "I can't match this talent with 10,000!"
With that, he activated the aura flying machine and rushed towards Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
And Su Lang opened the properties panel.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: The best qualifications can be seen everywhere
paragraphs: "Properties panel!"
[Name]: Su Lang
[Race]: human
[Qualification Level]: Turbidity
[Realm level]: Intermediate general
[Attack level]: quasi-wuhuang+
[Defensive level]: Intermediate Wuwang+
[Shenfa Level]: Peak Wuwang
[Endurance level]: Intermediate Wuwang+
[Spirit level]: Condensed mist
[Mastering the exercises]: Boundless Heart Sutra, Blowing Snow Without Mark (Advanced, Perfect), Black Flame Record of Falling Sun (Advanced, Perfect), Wind Dance Taixu Jue (Advanced, Perfect)

Seven Stars Hidden Killing Blade (Advanced, Beginner), Fangtian Painting Halberd War Scroll (Advanced, Beginner), Lotus Leaf Wuqu Collection (Advanced, Beginner), Ziwu Xuanming Gong (Advanced, Beginner)
Guwen Phoenix Pattern Sutra (advanced, elementary), Xuanshen immovable scroll (advanced, elementary), Breath of Panshan (advanced, elementary), Giant God Training Technique (advanced, elementary)...
(Some exercises have been omitted)

[Activated system functions]: One-key practice function (level 11), one-key martial arts function (level 11), clone dispatch function (level 10), one-key treasure hunt function (level 10), one-key alchemy function (level 8) )
"The quasi-wuhuang-level attack level? Not bad."
Looking at the property panel, Su Lang nodded faintly.
It didn't take long.
The Aura aircraft stopped outside a huge mountain range.
Yes, it is a huge mountain range in the main city of Blue Star!
In the Eastern City, there is only one natural peak of Juewu Mountain, but there is more than one natural mountain in the main Blue Star City.
The mountain range that Su Lang had arrived at was named Xuanyuan, which was the residence of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
This shows how vast the main city of Blue Star is.
What a lofty status is Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, which occupies a mountain range in the city.
"Little brother, we ordinary people can't get in there."
Uncle Bald said apologetically: "I can only trouble you to take a few steps."
"it is good."
Su Lang nodded, paid the fare and got off the aircraft.
"It looks so high, it shouldn't let me down!"
Su Lang looked at the Xuanyuan Mountains from a distance, and all kinds of gorgeous buildings were faintly visible.
Thinking of this, Su Lang walked forward along the road with a trace of expectation.
Along the way, he would encounter some pedestrians from time to time.
Most of them are very young. Su Lang called up their attribute panel and found that they were all above the best qualifications.
And these young people also have different badges hanging on their chests.
Obviously, these people are human geniuses who studied in Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
"The best qualifications are everywhere."
A smile was drawn at the corner of Su Lang's mouth, "It is worthy of being the number one university that gathers global talents in one place."
Then, according to the map, Su Lang came outside a building.
This is a very simple wooden building with a total of only three floors, but it is very tall and magnificent. It looks like a historic building.
At this moment, under the wooden building, there are already many boys and girls aged fourteen or five lining up.
"It seems that a lot of people have come to be reviewed.
Su Lang thought, and then he was at the end of the line.
For the arrival of Su Lang, the students in front had basically no reaction.
However, a few arrogant looking guys showed a trace of contempt.
Obviously, Su Lang's age of 18 or 9 is a bit abrupt here.
At this time, a group of people came over.
There are four people in all, and they are also fourteen or five years old, but their arrogant temperament is almost going to the sky.
When seeing these four people, there was a burst of whisper among the team.
"He is the young master of the four great families of King Wu and Zheng of Xishan Zhou!"
"I didn't expect to meet them here. It is said that they are the Great Demon King!"
"Be quiet, or they will have your bitter fruit to eat."
There was a lot of discussion, and the eyes of the four teenagers were full of fear.
At this time, four extremely proud young men came to the front.
"Leave me all the way."
"The Fourth Young Master of Xishan is here, I don't want to be unlucky and hurry away."
The four dwarf boys stood aloft, looking like they were invincible.
When these four people spoke, the people in front of the line suddenly moved aside, revealing a road leading to the wooden building.
However, in the middle of this avenue, there was a man standing there like a nail, motionless.
This person, of course, is Su Lang!

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Only chance
paragraphs: "Lying down!"
"Does this guy dare not give way?"
"God, he still stood there still, and he sneered!"
"Hey, this guy must be a fool, right? The Fourth Young Master Xishan dare to provoke him?"
Seeing Su Lang standing in the middle of the road, everyone talked in disbelief.
At the same time, the Fourth Young Master of Xishan was also furious, and walked over with a bad face.
"Hey, kid!"
"We let you make way, are you deaf and can't hear?"
Four dudes surrounded Su Lang, each of them raised their chins and their nostrils were up into the sky.
"I am a person and never give way to others!"
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, "I didn't leave, you have to line up obediently."
"what?"
"This guy is so tough?"
"Never give way to the victim? Arrogant!"
"Oh, this guy's clothing style looks like a foreigner, he must be used to being rampant in the small bumps, I don't know the sky is high and the earth is thick!"
"Yes, yes, you see, this guy is eighteen or nineteen years old. He only came to review at this age. Rubbish, trash, I really think he is awesome."
"Haha, this idiot dares to provoke the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, and he will surely be taught that he doesn't even know him after a while!"
"Look, the show is about to begin!"
The boys and girls standing on the side whispered one after another, and their gazes at Su Lang were full of contempt and disdain.
Listening to the surrounding discussion, the Fourth Young Master of Xishan became even more arrogant.
"Have you heard, you, a fool from outside, dare to provoke the Fourth Young Master of Xishan?"
"I tell you, if you don't immediately kneel down and apologize to us, we will beat you so that your mother doesn't even know you!"
"Quick, right away, right away, kneel and kowtow to us!"
"Knock your head and get out of our sight roundly!"
"Otherwise, at your own risk!"
The four young masters of Xishan looked at Su Lang with contempt.
In their opinion, after listening to everyone's discussion and knowing his own name, Su Lang would of course be frightened and immediately convinced.
Then knelt down to apologize, and rolled away dingy!
However, an unexpected scene happened.
"The Four Young Masters of the West Mountain? I think you should be called the Four Fools of the West Mountain."
Su Lang glanced at the four dudes with disdain, "Originally you lined up obediently, so I let you go.
But if you have to die, don't blame me for teaching you your parents!
Now, each of you slaps yourself three times, and then leaves my sight, I will spare you!
There is only one opportunity, I hope you can take it well. "
Everyone was shocked when he said this.
The scene was as quiet as the air was freezing, and even a needle dropped could be clearly heard.
Immediately afterwards, everyone came back to their senses and immediately made incredible noises.
"This guy is so bold!"
"Not only do you say that the Fourth Young Master of Xishan is the Fourth Stupid of Xishan, but you dare to say that the parents of the Fourth Young Master of Xishan teach the Fourth Younger Xishan?
"Yes, each of the four major families of Xishan is extremely powerful, and the parents of the four youngest of Xishan are all Wuhuang Wuzun. This guy... is crazy!"
"Furthermore, he said it was so ridiculous that the Fourth Young Master Xishan slapped himself three times!"
Everyone looked at Su Lang who was standing alone in the middle of the road, their eyes seemed to be looking at a silly roe deer!
At the same time, the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, who was the person involved, was so angry that his eyes were cracked, and the Qi Qiao gave rise to smoke.
They have never been so humiliated since they were born.
This is simply a shame!
"Tubaozi, you successfully angered us!"
"Today, we will show you what cruelty is!"
"A mere mid-level military commander, cut him off first!"
The Fourth Young Master of Xishan drew out his weapon and slammed towards Su Lang with a grim expression.
"There is only one chance. Since you do it, don't blame me."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, and then he flicked with one hand, a terrifying force of ice and cold spilled out.
Immediately afterwards, the power of ice cold condensed into a huge ice palm, swept out with unmatched momentum!
"Boom boom boom!!"
Four muffled noises came, and the Four Young Masters of Xishan disappeared in place!
Take a closer look, they actually stuck to the huge ice palm like flies!

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Special class through the back door
paragraphs: The scene that had been a little noisy fell silent again.
Everyone looked at Su Lang's giant ice palms in disbelief, staring blankly, like sculptures!
Although the Four Young Masters of Xishan were arrogant and domineering, they had already cultivated to the level of generals.
The four generals were killed in seconds, exactly like the ants!
It was shocking, it was incredible!
At this time, Su Lang shook his giant cold ice palm, and the Fourth Young Master of Xishan suddenly fell to the ground like garbage.
Su Lang didn't want their lives, but the bones and tendons were broken.
Moreover, the Fourth Young Master of Xishan was invaded by the force of ice, so he didn't even want to move in a short time.
"What are you doing in a daze?"
Su Lang turned to look at the boys and girls who usually stood beside the sculpture, "Go, line up to get censored!"
However, no one dared to move!
"Since you are not going, don't blame me for jumping in line."
Su Lang smiled faintly, then stepped into the wooden building.
The conflict actually lasted just a few minutes.
When Su Lang walked into the wooden building, a teenager who had finished his examination just walked out with a smile.
It seemed that this young man passed the review and officially became a student of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
Following the signs, Su Lang came to a room on the first floor.
There is a black table in the room, behind which sits a small Huafa old man.
"I have seen Teacher Youlu."
Su Lang arched his hands and said.
"Well, what's your name?
"Take a look at the token that the admissions tutor gave you."
The old man Huafa, that is, You Lu glanced at Su Lang, and his expression was a bit dismissive.
Obviously, he saw that Su Lang was almost twenty years old and his cultivation level was not too high. He thought this was a bad seed.
You must know that in this main city of Blue Star, young people who reached the rank of military commander at the age of sixteen or seven are really walking on the ground.
"This is given to me by Mentor Ren Tianfeng."

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Luohuashan Fair
paragraphs: Su Lang didn't know what everyone was saying.
But even if he knew it, he would curl his lips in disdain, and then leave on his own.
At this time, he was checking the badge given to him by You Lu.
This is a cyan badge with intricate and gorgeous patterns on the front and the words "Xuanyuan Wudao Academy" written on it.
The back of the badge is simpler than the front, but it is also very sophisticated, with the words "potential students" inscribed.
"Potential students, at first glance, they are the lowest level..."
Shrugging his shoulders, Su Lang took out the space ring and checked it.
There is a school motto, a handbook for freshmen, a key, a map, and retro school uniforms.
Su Lang took out the school motto and looked at it.
It records the history of the formation of the institution, mentors, celebrities, etc.
Xuanyuan Wudao Academy is the largest institution of Blue Star, and its history is as long as that of the main city of Blue Star, for a whole thousand years!
In other words, the cracks in time and space first appeared, and when the Fengling clan invaded, it was the time when Xuanyuan Wudao Academy was established.
This highest school is divided into four gates: Zhanmen, Danmen, Qimen, and Zhenmen.
As the name suggests, the battle gate is dedicated to teaching combat, and the pill gate device gate array gate is to teach the alchemy refining device to refine the formation.
In addition to the brief descriptions of the subjects, there are also introductions by academic tutors, introductions of important buildings, and various rules, all of which Su Lang swept away.
After reading the school motto, Su Lang took out the freshman manual and flipped it through.
"It turns out that the students are divided into six levels: potential, silver, gold, platinum, purple gold, and Hall of Fame."
"Each level can enjoy corresponding knowledge benefits, teaching resources, and material benefits.
"The way to upgrade the level is to assess, the battle gate is to fight, and the other three are to refine the alchemy and refine the formation."
Su Lang silently read the freshman manual, then took out the map and walked towards the "Wuwei Mountain" marked on it.
Wuwei Mountain is where the potential students live.
Soon, Su Lang arrived at his destination-a two-story building with a courtyard on Wuwei Mountain.
This small building is his residence!
"It is worthy of being the Blue Star's first university, even potential students have a separate residence."
"Moreover, in addition to privacy, the concentration of aura here is also very high, very good."
Su Lang nodded in satisfaction, then took out the key to open the door and walked in.
The interior decoration of the wooden building is also very luxurious, and each layout is extremely elegant, which makes one look refreshing.
When he came to the balcony, Su Lang found that he could overlook a large area of Blue Star City, and his vision was very wide.
At this time, a few students passed by on the small road not far downstairs.
"I heard that the seniors are holding a trading conference in Luohuashan!"
"All the good things they don't need are sold to our new students at a discount!"
"Really, then we have to go and see, maybe we can find something good 1"
Everyone went away with a little excitement, but they didn't know that their comments had fallen into Su Lang's ears.
"Trade meeting?"
"There are a lot of unwanted things in my space ring, so I can just sell some."
Su Lang raised his brows and smiled, "The guys who can come here for further study generally don't lack spirit stones. Maybe they can make a lot of money this time, but it's not necessarily true!"
Thinking of this, Su Lang changed into his school uniform, then concealed his appearance and rushed towards Luohua Mountain.
The things he wants to sell are of high level and large quantity.
If you don't hide your appearance, you may cause unnecessary trouble.
While walking on the road, Su Lang met many students who also went to Luohua Mountain, including many veteran students.
It can be seen that this trading conference is indeed quite lively.
Soon, Su Lang arrived at Luohua Mountain.
This is a low hill, but the scenery is very beautiful, it is not an exaggeration to say that it is beautiful.
At this time, various stalls were lined up at the foot of the mountain.
The stall owners did not yell, just sitting behind the stall quietly waiting for the buyer to choose.
Su Lang walked around with great interest, and found that the things sold by these seniors were really high-quality and cheap for new students, and they were not cheating at all.
After walking around, Su Lang also harvested some unheard-of pill, enriching the types of pill that he could refine.
Soon, he chose an empty place and stopped.
"Just set up a stall here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Su Lang's Super Grocery Store
paragraphs: Su Lang waved his hand, and a spear and two large animal skins appeared on the ground.
Spreading one of the skins on the ground, Su Lang used a spear and another skin to make a sign.
On the signboard were five characters "Super Grocery Store".
Putting the sign on the ground, Su Lang completed his simple stall.
Immediately afterwards, he took out a large amount of useless pills, weapons, animal materials, space rings, etc. from the storage space, and piled the stalls full!
These items come from the spoils of Su Lang's killing of enemies and the looting of major clans in the Eastern City.
And he also took out a lot of blank jade slips, entered his practice experience into it, and sold them!
And this stall full of goods soon attracted some students.
"Wow! This mysterious senior has so many good things!"
"Hey, that's Tianxuan Zhicaobao Dan, it looks so high-quality!"
"Hey, these pills are piled up here like rubbish, is this senior so headstrong?"
"Wow, these animal materials are handled perfectly, but unfortunately I bought it for no use, and I don't know how to refine weapons."
"Senior, is your bottle of Tianquan Zijin Qidan top-quality? It looks so beautiful!"
"Senior, how do you sell this high-level genius?"
The new students gathered in front of Su Lang's booth, one by one, their eyes dazzling.
"For the sake of your new students, I will give you a bit cheaper, and all goods will be 10% off!"
"However, if you are interested in the same item, then the higher price will get.
Su Lang said faintly, "This junior, this high-level psychic mad dragon lotus will sell you 10 million gold coins."
"10 million gold coins, good!"
The junior happily took out the spirit stone and handed it to Su Lang, then took the weapon happily.
However, he did not leave there, but continued to look for what he needed.
The transaction of the first piece of goods also raised the desire of the other students to buy.
"Senior, I want this bottle of the best medicine, how many spirit stones?"
"Senior, I want this supreme quality Tai Xuan Rong Ling Ba Pill!"
"Hey, I saw it first, don't grab it!"
Everyone began to rush to buy them, and the hot scene suddenly attracted more students.
Even some veteran students took their booths and went to Su Lang to watch the excitement.
Not long after, Su Lang's booth was surrounded by water.
Then, the students who followed up were all shocked!
"Look, look, that jade slip contains all the experience of advanced attribute skills from entry to completion!"
"Wow, this senior actually masters the consummation level advanced attribute exercises, this comprehension is too strong!"
"Wow! Isn't the pile of pill in the corner the best pill? Not even a medicine bottle?"
"My goodness, this senior must be a high-level student of Danmen, at least a gold-level student!"
"Let's not stop it, you see there is a king-level pill, this senior is probably a platinum-level pill student!
"This senior is really awesome, so many high-end medicines are piled up here for sale like groceries!"
"Stop talking, I'm going to buy a pill. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!"
"I'm fond of that superb Purifying Purple Vein Pill, don't grab it with me!"
"What? I just want to buy the marrow purple vein pill, you go away!"
"Nima, I was interested in it first, and you will grab my fare!"
"If you increase the price, increase the price, I'm afraid of you!"
More and more people have joined the panic buying army.
The students who set up the stalls also closed the stalls and rushed over, the scene was once chaotic.
However, after Su Lang exposed an extremely high and dangerous aura, many students suddenly became extremely polite.
Immediately afterwards, the students who came to the groundnut to participate in the trade conference found that there was only one booth selling things in the entire trade fair!
And at this stall, except for alchemy materials, almost everything is sold!
Immediately afterwards, later students also joined the panic buying.
In addition, some people took out the jade card of Chuanxin to call friends and call friends, and more and more students were gathered to buy them.
Although it was sold at a 10% discount, from time to time there were people bidding to buy it, and they were beaten up.
This makes the spirit stones that Su Lang harvests are even higher than they are sold at market prices!
In the midst of the students' rush to buy, a large number of spirit stones poured into Su Lang's storage space like a flood, which made him happy!

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Shangyang Mountain Hall of Fame
paragraphs: It was night in a blink of an eye.
I have to say that the students of Xuanyuan Budo Academy have too strong purchasing power.
Especially the advanced students who joined in later, these people did not blink their eyes when they increased the price.
After most of the sales, although the debris in Su Lang's storage space has not been processed, most of it has been sold.
This allowed Su Lang to harvest more than 15 million middle-grade spirit stones!
However, by this time, the remaining living creatures are basically not selling well.
The enthusiasm of the students has also been reduced by more than half.
If Su Lang took out the perfect quality pill to sell, it would definitely make the scene hot immediately.
But he did not intend to do so.
The perfect quality pill is too glaring.
Secondly, the spirit stones of the students were almost squeezed by him.
Even if the students bid for the purchase, they can't sell it at a high price.
Su Lang planned to find a suitable opportunity to find a shop outside and sell them all.
"Okay, it's almost sold!"
Su Lang waved his hand to close the booth, waved his hand and said, "Everyone, go back."
As soon as this statement came out, the students immediately sighed unwillingly.
But Su Lang was already a high-ranking platinum student in their eyes. They didn't dare to offend, so they could only obediently disperse.
Seeing the students who turned their heads one step at a time, Su Lang smiled dumbly before turning around and leaving.
When I returned to the courtyard.
Su Lang found a letter stuck in the door of the small building.
Open it and take a look.
"Small things!"
"I didn't expect you to be a counselor, so you hide in other places.
"But it doesn't matter, as long as you are at Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy, don't even want to escape our palms."
"We will definitely stop you from crying every day, crying hard!"
"Fourth Master Xishan stay!"
The handwriting was red, which was enough to show how angry the Fourth Young Master Xishan was and how hated Su Lang was.
"It seems...have not learned enough!"
Su Lang sneered, and burned the letter with a fire.
Soon, he walked into the small building and fell asleep.
the next morning.
Su Lang woke up leisurely.
"Tuk tuk!"
There was a knock on the door.
"Are you so anxious to find death?"
Su Lang looked coldly, and then raised his eyebrows.
The person outside was not the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, but a female student with a golden student badge.
"It looks like it shouldn't be the fault."
While thinking, Su Lang went downstairs and opened the door.
"Hello, are you Su Lang, a student of this special class?"
The female student smiled lightly and said, "I am Jiang Yudie, the assistant teacher of Anxin Instructor, to inform you of something.
Your specialty class has already been enrolled, so classes start earlier than other classes.
Before ten o'clock, you have to arrive at Room 603, Building F, Shangyangshan. Don't be late.
Where's your jade pass? Let's add the contact information, and I will send it to your Chuanyutai for future courses. "
"Passing on the jade card, here it is."
Su Lang took out a jade medal from the storage space.
This is one of the items in the space ring given by You Lu.
Jiang Yudie took Su Lang's letter-passing jade card, and then took out her own letter-passing jade card and stacked them together.
In a short while, a connection was established between the two Chuanxin jade tiles.
"I'm going to notify other students, goodbye."
Jiang Yudie waved and left Su Lang's small courtyard.
"I didn't expect to have class so soon."
"In class... I really miss that time."
Su Lang smiled slightly, and then hurried towards Shangyang Mountain
——At this time, he had already remembered the entire Xuanyuan Academy's map in his heart.
About ten minutes later, Su Lang arrived at Shangyang Mountain.
This is a very long and long trapezoidal peak, with numerous buildings constructed from bottom to top.
The higher the building, the more magnificent and gorgeous.
On the top of the mountain, there is a super luxurious hall. Su Lang knew that it was the Hall of Fame.

The trainees in the Hall of Fame are the highest honorary title of the trainees. There are only forty people in the Hall of Fame. There are four students in the battle pill formation, ten people each.
Once you become a Hall of Fame student, you can leave your own sculpture inside!
"If you become a student in the Hall of Fame, you can enjoy the highest level of student treatment in Xuanyuan Budo Academy."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "Soon, there will be a place for me in that hall!"

the next morning.
Su Lang woke up leisurely.
"Tuk tuk!"
There was a knock on the door.
"Are you so anxious to find death?"
Su Lang looked coldly, and then raised his eyebrows.
The person outside was not the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, but a female student with a golden student badge.
"It looks like it shouldn't be the fault."
While thinking, Su Lang went downstairs and opened the door.
"Hello, are you Su Lang, a student of this special class?"
The female student smiled lightly and said, "I am Jiang Yudie, the assistant teacher of Anxin Instructor, to inform you of something.
Your specialty class has already been enrolled, so classes start earlier than other classes.
Before ten o'clock, you have to arrive at Room 603, Building F, Shangyangshan.
Don't be late.
Where's your jade pass?
Let's add the contact information, and I will send it to your Chuanyutai for future courses.
"Passing on the jade card, here it is."
Su Lang took out a jade medal from the storage space.
This is one of the items in the space ring given by You Lu.
Jiang Yudie took Su Lang's letter-passing jade card, and then took out her own letter-passing jade card and stacked them together.
In a short while, a connection was established between the two Chuanxin jade tiles.
"I'm going to notify other students, goodbye."
Jiang Yudie waved and left Su Lang's small courtyard.
"I didn't expect to have class so soon."
"In class...
I really miss that time."
Su Lang smiled slightly, and then hurried towards Shangyang Mountain
——At this time, he had already remembered the entire Xuanyuan Academy's map in his heart.
About ten minutes later, Su Lang arrived at Shangyang Mountain.
This is a very long and long trapezoidal peak, with numerous buildings constructed from bottom to top.
The higher the building, the more magnificent and gorgeous.
On the top of the mountain, there is a super luxurious hall.
Su Lang knew that it was the Hall of Fame.
The trainees in the Hall of Fame are the highest honorary title of the trainees.
There are only forty people in the Hall of Fame.
There are four students in the battle pill formation, ten people each.
Once you become a Hall of Fame student, you can leave your own sculpture inside!
"If you become a student in the Hall of Fame, you can enjoy the highest level of student treatment in Xuanyuan Budo Academy."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "Soon, there will be a place for me in that hall!"

chapters.title: Chapter 243: See the four fools of Xishan again
paragraphs: With full confidence, Su Lang came to Class 603 of Building F.
At this time, there were quite a few people sitting in the classroom, and Su Lang glanced around and found that they were mostly dudes.
Basically, they are all top-grade qualifications, or guys with not bad qualifications but very poor in other aspects.
"Sure enough, they all go through the back door."
Su Lang curled his lips and walked into the classroom.
"Oh~ here's another one! This guy is twenty years old, right?"
"Intermediate general level? This age, this cultivation level, is worse than mine."
"Haha, your eldest brother doesn't talk about the second elder brother, it's all rubbish, which is like me, I am the highest quality!
"What about your best aptitude? It's hard to practice an intermediate technique just with your understanding."
"I cross, can you mention one more thing?"
"Just mention it!"
Everyone talked for a while, and then went to do their own thing.
Su Lang glanced at the classroom and found names written on the desks, so he found his seat and sat down.
"Su Lang? Which family are you from?"
"It's a good background to be able to enter the special class, but why haven't I met you?"
"There is no very powerful Su family in this blue star main city. Could it be that you came from a different place?"
Next to him, a pale, over-indulgent panda-eyed teenager asked curiously.
"Well, out of town."
Su Lang nodded faintly.
To be honest, he has no interest in talking to these little kids.
"You turned out to be a foreigner!"
"For those from other places who have entered the specialty class, are you really a specialty student?
"Wow, it's so rare, the specialty class actually has a specialty student!"
The panda-eyed boy was surprised, "Man, talk about it, what are you good at?"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows: "I'm—the specialty there!"
The corners of the panda-eyed boy's mouth twitched and he was speechless.
At this time, a few more figures walked in outside.
The appearance of these two, five or eighty thousand guys immediately made the classroom a lot quieter.
"Who?"
Su Lang looked up, hey, acquaintance!
The four guys who walked in, who are many of the four fools of Xishan?
And when Su Lang saw the four fools of Xishan, the four fools of Xishan also saw Su Lang.
In an instant, the four people's eyes widened and a burst of fury broke out.
"Little crap, it's you!!"
"Unexpectedly, you are also a student in the specialty class!"
"It takes no effort to break through the iron shoes and find nowhere to find it!"
"Hmph, I want to see who your name is, oh, Su Lang? Never heard of it!"
"A little-known clerk who dares to provoke the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, I tell you, you are dead!"
The four silly Xishan stared at Su Lang angrily, like four pufferfish about to explode in anger.
"You guys..."
Su Lang curled his lips in disdain, "Is it not enough to dislike the lesson I received yesterday?"
As soon as this remark came out, the face of the Fourth Young Master Xishan suddenly turned blue and red.
Under the eyes of everyone, they were cleaned up by Su Lang like flies. It was a great shame.
At the same time, other students in the classroom were in an uproar when they heard what Su Lang said.
The Four Young Masters of Xishan are among the best in their generation.
It was only the Fourth Young Master Xishan who took care of others. Now this Su Lang has taken care of the Fourth Young Master Xishan, and I don't know if it is a good one or a fool...
"Humph!"
"Don't think you beat us once, it's amazing!"
"We have made a brand new preparation, and we are bound to make you pay today!"
While talking, the four young masters of Xishan showed their murderous aura, and they wanted to do it.
"stop!"
A sharp sharp shout sounded at the door.
Everyone joined together, turning their heads to look over.
I saw a woman with white, black, bright eyes and white teeth, and a slightly sickly temperament standing at the door with an angry expression on her face.
And beside her, stood golden student Jiang Yudie.
"It's Anxin mentor!"
"Sure enough, it's as beautiful as the rumors!"
"You can keep your voice down, this instructor has a bad temper. You can't eat it if you anger her!"
Some students lowered their heads and started talking in a low voice.
At the same time, the four young masters of Xishan looked stagnant, and ran out of murderous aura one after another.
