chapters.title: Chapter 244: The sixth and seventh system functions!
paragraphs: "You guys!"
"Does it mean that the university is not yours?"
"I tell you, no matter what your background, you must follow the rules in the college!"
"If you have contradictions, you can go to the victory ring to solve them, and if you have big grudges, you can go to the life and death ring to solve them."
"If you dare to violate the rules and have a private fight in the academy, don't blame me for driving you out of the Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy!"
Instructor An Xin walked into the classroom with a cold face, her petite body exuding a slight sense of majesty.
With her reprimand, the entire classroom was suddenly silent.
Although almost all the guys here are going through the back door, the power behind them is not small.
But they knew that if Anxin instructor really wanted to drive them away, it would definitely not take much effort.
The position of Xuanyuan Wudao Academy is aloof, and the position of academy tutor is also aloof!
Instructor Anxin stepped onto the podium and stared at everyone condescendingly.
After a while, the pink lips opened up.
"Specialty class is a compromise of the university to you, but this does not mean that you can get along without worry."
"Students who fail to achieve their goals within the prescribed period of training will automatically lose their status as students!"
"Next, I will prepare four classes for you, fighting, alchemy, weapon refining, and formation to determine the direction of your further training."

Having said this, the instructor Anxin turned his head to look at Jiang Yudie, "Yudie, you guard them, I will be back at ten o'clock, and all the students who are late will be recorded and expelled from the university."
"Understood, Anxin Mentor!
Jiang Yudie nodded heavily.
Immediately, Anxin instructor turned straight and left.
Seeing the back of Anxin instructor leaving, all the students breathed out one after another.
Su Lang didn't care too much, and he was lost in thought.
"Determine the direction of further study."
"Just forget about refining the array."
"The only choices I can choose are Zhanmen and Danmen."
"Whether it is through combat or alchemy, I can quickly upgrade the student level and enjoy more generous benefits."
"Warmen trainees can watch various exercises, experience, and get guidance from the strong when they reach advanced levels."
"Pill students who are promoted to advanced levels can watch various pill codes and prescriptions and use academic resources to refine pill medicine."
"At present, my exercises have not been completed yet. Choosing a battle gate can only be regarded as icing on the cake."
"If I choose the Danmen, I can use the resources of the university to refine the pill, replace it with spirit stones, and upgrade the system functions."
"In contrast, the benefits of choosing Danmen are significantly greater."
After determining the direction of further studies, Su Lang fell asleep bored.
The other students also slouched on the table and spoke.
An hour passed in a blink of an eye, during which many students came one after another.
There was no guy who was directly dismissed because of being late.
At this time, Anxin instructor also walked into the classroom with long legs.
Suddenly, all the students sat up, for fear of angering An Xin.
"Now start the first class, practice formation."
Instructor Anxin didn't get muddled, and with a wave of his small hand, a set of pens appeared on the table.
Jiang Yudie took the pen and handed it out, one set per person.
"Do you practice formation?"
Su Lang held the array pen and raised his eyebrows, "My perverted system has a one-key alchemy, I don't know if there will be a formation?"
"Ding! When the host upgrades all the first six functions to level 10, you can activate the one-key formation function!"
The sudden system prompt made Su Lang's eyes bright.
"Noisy, there really is a training function!"
"Good, once this function is activated, won't I be able to refine the magic circle as easily as alchemy?"
"It's... the first six functions? I only have five functions activated now!"
"So what is the sixth function?"
Su Lang pondered, and immediately asked tentatively, "System, is the sixth function a one-key mixer?"
"Ding! The sixth function is the one-key mixer function, which can be activated when the current five functions are all upgraded to level 10!"
"My fork, it really is a one-key mixer!"
"If I activate the One-Key Refining Device and One-Key Refining Array, wouldn't the speed at which I make money double again?"
The pleasant system prompt made Su Lang smile with excitement.

paragraphs: Just when Su Lang was excited.
"Su Lang!"
An Xin's clear voice resounded through the classroom, "What are you giggling? What was the first sentence I just said?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone gloated at Su Lang.
Su Lang's mouth twitched, "I don't know eh."
"Hahahaha!"
"This guy is so straightforward."
"I just said that I didn't know it, which made me laugh."
Everyone burst into laughter, especially the Fourth Young Master of Xishan, tears came out of laughter.
"do not know?"
"Obviously, it's hard to enter the specialty class, you are not serious yet, do you want to be dismissed?"
An Xin said Su Lang for a while, then frowned and looked at other students, "And you, why are you smiling, aren't you the same?"
As soon as this word came out, everyone stopped laughing.
"You people are really hopeless."
An Xin sighed, then continued to lecture.
The students below looked at each other, and then continued to listen to the class lazily.
Not long after, Anxin finished the basic training and began to demonstrate by hand.
However, after she performed some operations, the students all looked confused.
"Who understands?"
"No? No one?"
"Then I will say it again, you guys listen carefully!"
An Xin patted his forehead weakly, and immediately explained it again.
This time it was more detailed, but the students were still confused.
There is no way. Formation refining is a more complicated thing than alchemy refining. It requires higher talent and requires more time and energy.
Although most of the students present are high-ranking nobles, the family can afford to hire good masters.
However, none of these young students are willing to learn.
"Well, let's move on to the next class, refining tools."
Sighing, An Xin also knew that there were no students who could enter the gate.
Next, is the refining course.
An Xin took out a set of kits and was distributed by Jiang Yudie to the students.
Soon, the refining course officially began.
This time, some students followed Anxin’s courses, and from time to time they could interact with teachers and students, which made Anxin breathe a sigh of relief.
However, there is no Su Lang among these students.
He who can activate the one-key mixer, why do he learn this?
So he continued to doze off bored.
"Su Lang!"
"How much do you understand about refining tools?"
An Xin noticed Su Lang again, no way, Su Lang is too casual.
Su Lang returned to his senses and replied with a smile, "I didn't understand a bit!"
"puff!!"
The boy with dark circles next to him smiled directly!
"Looking noisy, Su Lang is absolutely amazing!"
"I thought I only understood three sentences, which is already the worst. I didn't expect him to be even better."
"The key is that he doesn't understand it, so he dared to say it with confidence, my day, awesome!"
All the students looked at Su Lang one after another, their faces full of contempt.
"Su Lang, you are for fun, right?"
An Xin's expression became cold, and she stared at Su Lang with sullen beautiful eyes.
"No, mentor."
Su Lang smiled faintly, "I think it's not good not to answer you, and it's not good to lie, so I just tell the truth, I really don't understand at all."
"you!"
An Xin held her forehead with her hand, "You are really hopeless!"
"Teacher, why am I not saved?"
Su Lang smiled blankly, "I am not good at refining arrays, I have other specialties!"
"Oh?"
"Then what are your specialties?"
An Xin's expression moved, and he asked with a hint of expectation.
Before Su Lang finished speaking, he was interrupted by the black eye boy next to him.
"Report mentor!"
The dark eye boy said loudly, "I know, he said he is good at it!"
As soon as this statement came out, the entire classroom suddenly exploded like a bowl of water poured into a boiling oil pan!
"Wow, I'm so ridiculous!"
"Hahahaha, but that is indeed a specialty!"
"Su Lang, Su Lang, you are so awesome, we admire you!"
All the students laughed, and cast contempt, cynicism and sneer at Su Lang.
"Su Lang, are you serious?"
An Xin's face was gloomy, and his voice had no emotion.
"Then... also count it."
Su Lang smiled slightly and said, "But my real specialty is alchemy!"

"That is, there are many similarities in refining alchemy. Since you are good at refining alchemy, how about answering your instructor's questions about refining?"
"Don't let him answer, he just said it, and didn't understand a bit!"
"He is a liar, trash!"

"It's all quiet!"

However, his mouth was closed, but his contemptuous gaze remained unchanged.
"Su Lang, are you really good at alchemy?"

"Ok."

"Well, now the refining course is almost the same, we will enter the alchemy course."

"Let's talk about the simplest body tempering pill."
"This is a Tier 2 pill, which can be taken by the body temperer to shorten the body temper time."
"Its material formula is very simple: Sanri Bing, Peach Nectar, Yuhewu and Qin Mucao."
"In the first step, we need to perform preliminary treatment on these alchemy materials to remove a large amount of impurities and obtain a relatively pure liquid medicine."
"The second step, we need...
An Xinzi explained the refining method of Body Tempering Pill carefully.
Immediately, she looked at Su Lang: "Su Lang, do you understand?"
"of course."
Su Lang smiled lightly, "I would have refined this pill long ago."
"In that case."
An Xin nodded, "Then it is up to you to demonstrate for everyone."
As soon as this statement was made, all the students immediately became excited.
In their view, Su Lang was just talking big.
So they are all waiting for Su Lang to make a fool of himself!
"Good mentor."
Su Lang smiled, and a black flame emerged between his fingers, wrapping the pill furnace.

At this time.
"Sishan four fools, I have refined the medicine."

"how?"

All he did before was to see Su Lang's jokes.

The black-eyed teenager showed horror, if he really shit, wouldn't it be a joke for the whole school?
Besides, it is the Four Young Masters of Xishan who want to eat shit.
If he dares to pull, he will directly offend the Fourth Young Master of Xishan!
"Hehe, if you don't pull it, I'll you out of shit, and then let Xishan Sifang eat it!"
Su Lang looked around and sneered again and again.
"okay."
An Xin's clear voice came, "If there are conflicts, they will be resolved privately."
"Since the instructor has spoken."
"Then I will let your trash go for the time being."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth twitched, "But today's matter is not over. Sooner or later, the five of you will have to and eat shit.
As soon as this statement was made, all the students immediately took a breath.
They never expected Su Lang to be so strong, and they must eat less shit.
The Fourth Young Master of Xishan and the teenager with dark circles as the parties were even more angry.
But the Anxin mentor was present, they didn't dare to attack, they could only endure it forcibly.
"Su Lang."
"Your alchemy talent is very strong."
"I decided to let you join Dan Sect and accept you as a closed disciple."
"From now on, I will personally teach you the way of alchemy, are you willing?"
An Xin looked at Su Lang with scorching eyes, and she was really excited when she met such a genius and beautiful jade.
And Anxin's decision also made everyone present envy and jealous.
Even the assistant teacher Jiang Yudie opened her mouth wide, with a look of envy.
You know, in Xuanyuan Academy, every tutor's status is extremely high.
And once a student becomes a closed disciple of his instructor, his status will rise!
Besides, there is a mentor who is covered, not to mention that you can run wild in the academy, at least you will not be bullied!
However, for Su Lang, becoming a disciple of Anxin didn't have much appeal.
"Become a closed disciple of the mentor?"
Su Lang raised an eyebrow noncommittal.
Now, he has upgraded the one-key pill refining to level 8, and he can refine a martial arts pill of perfect quality!
In other words, Su Lang is already a pill-level figure, and An Xin is just a better pill emperor.
"Not bad!"
"Becoming my closed disciple can not only get my guidance at any time, but also get many welfare privileges!"
"For example, you can go to class with ordinary students without step-by-step, and your time will be very free.
"For example, if you go to the alchemy building to refine pills, you can enjoy mentor-level treatment, and the purchase of materials has a very large discount.
An Xin smiled slightly, a pair of beautiful eyes shone slightly, "For example..."
"Good good!"
"I am willing to be a closed disciple of the mentor!"
Su Lang was delighted and immediately agreed.
Only the preferential purchase of materials and the freely arranged time made him unable to refuse!
"In that case, Su Lang, from now on you will be my closed disciple and my only disciple!"
An Xin also showed joy, "Don't worry, I will never let your talent get dusty, I will definitely make you a world-famous alchemist!"
"Good good!"
Su Lang chuckled, "I would like to ask Anxin instructor to take care of me."
"You should call me master now!"
An Xin smiled slightly, that look, how gentle and gentle!
"Master is here, please be respected by the disciple."
Su Lang smiled lightly, and pretended to say a little bit.
His actions immediately made An Xin happier.
And this scene fell in the eyes of the surrounding students, and suddenly aroused more intense envy and hatred.
Some students swallowed with envy, and some students' eyes flushed with jealousy.
Among them, the Fourth Young Master of Xishan and the young man with dark circles are even more resentful.
Su Lang became the closed disciple of Anxin Mentor at this time, and it would be difficult for them to retaliate against each other!

"Go outside the city, deep in the Wolong Mountains!"

"gift!?"
"What gift is in the mountains?"
Su Lang raised his eyebrows and asked curiously, "Could it be some kind of treasure?
"It is not wrong to say that it is a treasure of heaven, material and earth."
An Xin smiled and nodded, "Because, what I want to give you is strange fire!"
"Different fire?"
Su Lang was surprised, and he didn't expect An Xin to give him this gift.
"Not bad!"
"As an alchemist, you must have a flame that you can handle."
"Although you have a high-level fire attribute technique, it is not the most suitable flame for alchemy after all."
"The abnormal fire I plan to send you is called Ziwei Wuding Fire. Its temperature and shape are changeable. It is most suitable for refining pills."
An Xin smiled slightly and said, "You don't have to worry about not being able to refine the alien fire, because the alien fire is a new kind of fire, which is very easy to refine."
"The new fire?"
Su Lang was surprised, "Then why don't you refining, Master?"
"I have refined it."
"But that place is very magical."
"Every 100 years, a fire will condense there again."
"The crape myrtle, which has been condensed in the past 100 years, has been refined by me."
An Xin smiled and shook his fingers, and a purple flame appeared in the air like smoke.
"That's it!"
Su Lang nodded suddenly, and immediately showed a trace of surprise on his face, "Master, are you over a hundred years old?"
"Yes!"
"Is it weird?"
"There are a lot of 500-year-old monsters in the academy!
"We who are over 120 years old are completely young people."
"The way of martial arts is cultivated to a high level, and the life span of the warrior will increase significantly."
"The long years in the eyes of ordinary people are just a flash in the eyes of martial arts experts."

"That's what I said."

"But lived for more than a thousand years..."
An Xin said very positively, "As far as I know, there is more than one person."
"Lie noisy, live for more than a thousand years!"
Su Lang stunned to himself, "So awesome? Who are these people?"

"And the founder of our Xuanyuan Budo Academy, is also the founder of the Martial Arts Alliance-Yanxingxing."
An Xin said, "Besides, there should be other hidden super bosses."
"More than a thousand years."

"As far as I know, Yan Xingxing's predecessor has already broken through to the realm of Valkyrie."
An Xin showed admiration, "It is precisely because of him that controls the Fengling Clan in the Canglan Continent, so that our Blue Star can have more breathing opportunities."

"Lie noisy, live for more than a thousand years!"
Su Lang stunned to himself, "So awesome?
Who are these people?"
"The patriarchs of three hidden families."
"And the founder of our Xuanyuan Budo Academy, is also the founder of the Martial Arts Alliance-Yanxingxing."
An Xin said, "Besides, there should be other hidden super bosses."
"More than a thousand years."
Su Lang nodded and said, "I don't know what level of cultivation they are?"
"As far as I know, Yan Xingxing's predecessor has already broken through to the realm of Valkyrie."
An Xin showed admiration, "It is precisely because of him that controls the Fengling Clan in the Canglan Continent, so that our Blue Star can have more breathing opportunities."

paragraphs: "The realm of Valkyrie?"
"Canglan Continent!?"
"That's where the Wind Spirit Race is?"
Su Lang was surprised, "But isn't that another time and space? How could Senior Yanxingxing be there?"
"Yes, the place where the Wind Spirit Clan is located is Canglan Continent."
"The Canglan Continent is a super world a million times larger than the earth!"
"In the Canglan Continent, both the concentration of spiritual energy and the cultivation resources exceed our Blue Star."
"And precisely because of this, there are many powerful races on the Canglan Continent, and the martial arts civilization is more prosperous."
"On the Canglan Continent, the level of the of war is no more than entering the house, and there are three realms of Wusheng, Wuxian, and Wudi above them!"
"And the history of martial arts civilization in Canglan Continent is tens of thousands of years. In the long time, the martial arts masters have created countless exercises."
"Many of the exercises on our Blue Star are passed on from there through the cracks in time and space."
"Currently, most of the exercises passed down from the Canglan Continent are from the Wind Spirit Race."
"There are many clans in the Canglan Continent, and the Fengling Clan is just a small race in the Canglan Continent."
"Of course, even if the Wind Spirit Clan is not prominent in Canglan Continent, it is still too strong for us Blue Star humans!"
"As for why Yan Xingxing was in the Canglan Continent, it was because we found a gap in time and space!"
"This space-time crack is not known to the Wind Spirit Race, and it was in our hands for the first time."
"Through this gap in time and space, the senior Yanxingxing led the human elite to establish a stronghold in the Canglan Continent."
"Every year, Xuanyuan Wudao Academy will send the most elite students to the Canglan Continent to practice."
"If you perform well enough, disciple, then you have the opportunity to travel to Canglan Continent to practice cultivation, that is the most suitable place to practice martial arts!
An Xin said a lot in one breath, and Su Lang was stunned!
It was a long time before Su Lang digested the information in An Xin's words, breathing a bit heavy involuntarily.
"It won't be long, the resources on Bluestar absolutely cannot support me to upgrade the system functions."
"But if I set foot on the Canglan Continent, with the resources of the Canglan Continent, I will definitely make my development faster."
"Furthermore, the Fengling Clan is in Canglan Continent, in other words, Ji Ruxue and Murong Xianxian are there!"
"I thought it would be difficult to see horror again, but I didn't expect that there would be such a path in Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy!"
Thinking of this, Su Lang has already made a decision-he must go to Canglan Continent!
However, he still has a question in his heart, he has to say.
"master."
"You said Canglan Continent is so prosperous."
Su Lang frowned and asked, "Why did the Wind Spirits come to invade our Blue Star projectile land?"
"I don't know this either."
An Xin shook his head and said, "But the wind spirit clan is invading, there must be a big secret on the blue star!"
"The big secret..."
"A secret enough to make the Wind Spirits coveted..."
Su Lang raised his eyebrows, and a strong interest rose in his heart.
At this time, the two had already reached the door of Xuanyuan Martial Arts Academy.
An Xin waved his hand, and a very cool aura aircraft appeared in front of him.
"Wow, handsome!
Su Lang stroked the Reiki aircraft and praised it.
"If you like, I will give you one in the future."
An Xin smiled at Su Lang, "Let's go, let's sit here and go to the Wolong Mountains."
With that, she turned on the Aura aircraft and sat in the cockpit.
"Wow, there was a master so cool."
Su Lang grinned, and then also sat in the flight cabin.
Immediately, the Aura aircraft unfolded its wings and flew out like lightning.

"An Xin accepted a disciple?"
An old man with a gloomy face looked surprised and repeatedly asked, "That disciple made a perfect quality medicine?"
In front of him, stood a golden student.
"Yes, Mentor Owen Yao!"
"The disciple will follow the instructions, always pay attention to An Xin and witness everything."
"An Xin accepted the male student named Su Lang as a closed disciple on the spot."
The golden student said respectfully, "Besides, An Xin didn't finish the class, so he left with her new disciple."
